heroes.name: Hulk
heroes.description: Brilliant scientist Dr. Bruce Banner has finally found a way to coexist with his monstrous alter ego, the Hulk. By accumulating gamma energy over transformations, he can become a wise and strong Hero Hulk or a fierce and destructive Monster Hulk – a true force of fury on the battlefield!

Teamup.name: SAVAGE SLAM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Leap high and smash the ground, dealing damage to enemies and reducing the cooldowns of other abilities based on remaining Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, the ground slam additionally applies Vulnerability to enemies hit.

Teamup.name: GAMMA FASTBALL
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Enter a Furious state upon activation, gaining Speed Boost and Attack Speed for a duration. Also unlocks the Scars of Rage ability, granting Unstoppable for a period when Health drops to a certain threshold.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Wolverine, unlocks the Fastball Special. Upon mutual confirmation, Hulk hurls Wolverine forward and enters Furious state.

Teamup.name: GAMMA MAELSTROM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Maelstrom of Madness to Gamma Maelstrom. This drastically boosts energy charge rates and removes the Anti-Heal curse.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Gamma Maelstrom retains some energy, and stored Gamma energy doesn't decay over time.

Teamup.name: GAMMA CHARGE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Armor Overdrive to Gamma Overdrive. In this state, Iron Man gains a Gamma Shield and can fire stronger Repulsor Blasts and Unibeams.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Invincible Invincible Pulse Cannon generates a Gamma Shield and heavily infuses the blast, creating a Gamma Pulse Cannon. Its radiation creates a damage increase while the projectile flies.

Teamup.name: GAMMA MONSTRO
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Summon an extra Gamma Monstro that continuously damages the nearest enemy. Upon landing critical hits, the Gamma Monstro gains increased Attack Speed. Hitting an enemy with Wrath of the Seven Seas prompts it to fire a powerful beam.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, casting Blessing of the Deep creates a water barrier infused with Gamma energy. Standing inside accelerates the Gamma Monstro cooldown and grants it a Damage Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: PUNY BANNER
ActiveAbilities.text: Transform from Bruce Banner into Hero Hulk.

ActiveAbilities.name: GAMMA RAY GUN
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire with a Gamma Ray Gun.

ActiveAbilities.name: GAMMA GRENADE
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a Gamma Grenade to inflict damage and Launch Up enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: HULK SMASH!
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash stored gamma energy, transforming from Hero Hulk into Monster Hulk for a limited time period. Gain immunity to Launch and Knockback effects.

ActiveAbilities.name: HEAVY BLOW
ActiveAbilities.text: Swing fists forward to punch enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: INCREDIBLE LEAP
ActiveAbilities.text: Hold SPACE to perform a charged leap that allows Hero Hulk to Knock Down flying enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: GAMMA BURST
ActiveAbilities.text: Emit gamma-ray bursts to inflict damage. Reduce Indestructible Guard cooldown upon hit.

ActiveAbilities.name: INDESTRUCTIBLE GUARD
ActiveAbilities.text: Generate gamma shields for Hero Hulk and nearby allies, absorbing and converting damage into energy for HULK SMASH!

ActiveAbilities.name: RADIOACTIVE LOCKDOWN
ActiveAbilities.text: Emit gamma energy to render enemies immobilized and immune to all ability effects. Using Heavy Blow or Gamma Burst will prematurely remove this status.

ActiveAbilities.name: WORLD BREAKER
ActiveAbilities.text: Grab and smash the enemy in front.

ActiveAbilities.name: HEAVY BLOW
ActiveAbilities.text: Swing fists forward to punch and launch up enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: INCREDIBLE LEAP
ActiveAbilities.text: Hold SPACE to perform a charged leap that allows Monster Hulk to Knock Down flying enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: GAMMA BURST
ActiveAbilities.text: Emit gamma-ray bursts to inflict damage. Reduce Indestructible Guard cooldown upon hit.

ActiveAbilities.name: RADIOACTIVE LOCKDOWN
ActiveAbilities.text: Emit gamma energy to render enemies immobilized and immune to all ability effects. Using Heavy Blow or Gamma Burst will prematurely remove this status.

heroes.name: The Punisher
heroes.description: Expertly wielding a full arsenal of futuristic weapons, Frank Castle is a formidable one-man army. With a steadfast resolve to deliver justice to his enemies, The Punisher won't cease in his mission until every last round is fired!

Teamup.name: AMMO OVERLOAD
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Throw an Ammo Overload Device in the target direction. Upon entering the device's range, receive Faster Firing.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the device grants Infinite Ammo and Faster Firing.

Teamup.name: BESTIAL HUNT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Shoot piercing bullets that carry a Damage Boost effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Daredevil, the bullets break enemy summoned walls and shields more quickly.

Teamup.name: TIMELESS VETERANS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unlocks the Burst Spike ability. Using the bionic arm emits forward electricity, dealing damage and Knocking Back enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the electric burst applies a Grounded effect and Knocks Back enemies even further.

Teamup.name: PRIMAL PUNISHMENT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Adds a new ability. Upon activation, Primal Bite is replaced. Devil Dinosaur gains 2 magnetic cannons that can be fired forward; the cannonballs detonate when hitting enemies or the environment, applying Bleed.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the duo can request an interaction. Once accepted, The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher.

ActiveAbilities.name: FINAL JUDGEMENT
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash two gatling guns and missiles to attack enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: ADJUDICATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire at enemies with Adjudication, his Automatic Rifle.

ActiveAbilities.name: DELIVERANCE
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire at enemies with Deliverance, his Shotgun.

ActiveAbilities.name: SCOURGE GRENADE
ActiveAbilities.text: Throw a smoke grenade forward to Block Enemies' Vision and leap backward.

ActiveAbilities.name: VANTAGE CONNECTION
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a hook to generate a cable that enables Punisher to move rapidly by pressing F.

ActiveAbilities.name: CULLING TURRET
ActiveAbilities.text: Deploy a Culling Turret that grounds Punisher and blocks damage from the front while dealing massive damage.

Passives.name: WARRIOR'S GAZE
Passives.text: Retain vision of enemies that disappear from view for a short duration.

heroes.name: Storm
heroes.description: An Omega-level Mutant ability to manipulate weather makes Ororo Munroe a force to be reckoned with. Rain or shine, thunder or lightning, nature itself bends to the command of the Goddess of the Storm!

Teamup.name: GODS OF THUNDER
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Wind Blade into a hitscan lightning beam that detonates upon striking a target.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor,Bolt Rush becomes Chain Lightning, allowing it to bounce from foe to foe.

Teamup.name: JAWS OF FATE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a torrential downpour that continuously heals both herself and her teammates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, casting Omega Hurricane allows Jeff to swim inside the cyclone, generating a localized Jeff-nado.

Teamup.name: STORMING IGNITION
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a storm-driven blaze of fire forward, generating a persistent Fire Vortex upon impact that continuously damages and pulls in enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, her Omega Hurricane ignites into a Burning Hurricane if it crosses a Flame Tornado. Furthermore, any Omega Hurricane, Jeff-Nado, or Burning Hurricane that sweeps across a Flame Field left by Human Torch will instantly generate a new Flame Tornado.

Teamup.name: DAMISA-YAO
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Trigger the elemental power stored within his armor, dealing damage and applying Slow to surrounding enemies while attaching Vibranium Marks.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, enemies within range are launched toward Black Panther.

Teamup.name: COSMIC CYCLONE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, linked teammates additionally gain a Damage Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: OMEGA HURRICANE
ActiveAbilities.text: Transform into a hurricane to draw in nearby enemies and deal damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: WIND BLADE
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch forward-piercing Wind Blades.

ActiveAbilities.name: BOLT RUSH
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash a lightning bolt forward.

ActiveAbilities.name: WEATHER CONTROL
ActiveAbilities.text: Switch the weather to empower allies: Tornado grants a Movement Boost. Gain Bonus Health when dealing damage with Wind Blade or Bolt Rush. Thunder grants a Damage Boost. Hitting enemies with Wind Blade reduces the cooldown of Bolt Rush and expands Bolt Rush's impact radius.

ActiveAbilities.name: GODDESS BOOST
ActiveAbilities.text: Channel the power of the weather to empower Storm: Tornado grants a Movement Boost and inflicts Slow on enemies; Thunder grants a Damage Boost and summons lightning to inflict damage.

heroes.name: Loki
heroes.description: What greater thrill is there for a God of Mischief than to outsmart his foes? The cunning trickster Loki uses his illusions and shapeshifting abilities to weave in and out of combat, toying with enemies at every turn.

Teamup.name: VIBRANT VITALITY
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Regeneration Domain provides a Damage Boost effect to allies within range; the Runestone triggers a psychic catalysis, expanding the domain's radius.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, deploying Regeneration Domain emits a shockwave of nature energy that damages enemies within the radius and slightly Launches them up.

Teamup.name: VILLAIN'S ILLUSION
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to target fallen heroes (friend or foe), letting Loki assume their form for a set time (cannot cast their Ultimate Ability).
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, Loki's transformation lasts slightly longer. Furthermore, taking lethal damage while transformed or in his Ultimate Ability state will merely revert him back to Loki with some Health, preventing a KO.

Teamup.name: ODIN'S UNACKNOWLEDGED
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Project an Illusion forward. The illusion utilizes Assassin's Charge to thrust at enemies. Enemies struck head-on will be carried through the air for a short while.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Loki, the ability gains two charges.

ActiveAbilities.name: MYSTICAL MISSILE
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire Mystical Missiles to heal allies or deal damage to enemies. Direct hits on allies provide extra healing.

ActiveAbilities.name: REGENERATION DOMAIN
ActiveAbilities.text: Use Rune Stones to create a magical field that provides allies Healing Over Time and converts incoming damage into further healing.

ActiveAbilities.name: DECEPTION
ActiveAbilities.text: Become Invisible and conjure an Illusion to deceive enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: DOPPELGANGER
ActiveAbilities.text: Project an Illusion that can cast some of Loki's abilities.

ActiveAbilities.name: DEVIOUS EXCHANGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Swap with the selected Illusion.

ActiveAbilities.name: GOD OF MISCHIEF
ActiveAbilities.text: Shapeshift into a targeted ally or enemy hero and use all their abilities except any of their Team-Up Abilities.

ActiveAbilities.name: BACKSTAB
ActiveAbilities.text: Pull out a dagger to stab enemies, dealing extra damage when attacking an enemy from behind.

heroes.name: Human Torch
heroes.description: The Fantastic Four's resident heartthrob, Johnny Storm, adds an intense flare to every battle he fights. Shrouded in roaring flames, the Human Torch always manages to look cool while turning up the heat!

Teamup.name: FIERY SPARKS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Passively detect enemies in the immediate vicinity and launch tracking Firework Sparks to chip away their health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, successfully landing a Firework Spark on an enemy grants Human Torch Bonus Health.

Teamup.name: STORMING IGNITION
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a storm-driven blaze of fire forward, generating a persistent Fire Vortex upon impact that continuously damages and pulls in enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, her Omega Hurricane ignites into a Burning Hurricane if it crosses a Flame Tornado. Furthermore, any Omega Hurricane, Jeff-Nado, or Burning Hurricane that sweeps across a Flame Field left by Human Torch will instantly generate a new Flame Tornado.

Teamup.name: UNITED SIBLINGS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Generate a Flame Shield for a targeted ally that blocks incoming damage while providing a Continuous Healing aura to everyone nearby. Projectiles from teammates shot through the Flame Shield receive a Damage Boost. Enemies that pass though the shield are Slowed
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, the Flame Shield boasts a larger radius and heavily increased shield value.

Teamup.name: TWO-IN-ONE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Enter an enhanced state upon activation. For the duration, The Thing's fists are violently engulfed in flames. Every Rocky Jab deals splash damage, and every Stone Haymaker creates an explosion, dealing damage in a frontal cone.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage and Stun to enemies. The Thing then automatically enters his flaming enhanced state upon landing.

ActiveAbilities.name: FIRE CLUSTER
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch forward a cluster of splitting fireballs.

ActiveAbilities.name: PLASMA BODY
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward, then enter a state of accelerated ascent. This ability has 2 charges.

ActiveAbilities.name: BLAZING BLAST
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a fireball to deal damage or create a Flame Field at the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies within.

ActiveAbilities.name: FLAMING METEOR
ActiveAbilities.text: Dive towards the ground, dealing damage to enemies. This will also detonate any Flame Fields hit and grant you Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: PYRO-PRISON
ActiveAbilities.text: When 2 or more Flame Fields exist, connect them to form a fire wall that deals one-off high damage to enemies that pass through the wall, or continuous burning damage if the wall exists in an enclosed area.

ActiveAbilities.name: SUPERNOVA
ActiveAbilities.text: Explode with cosmic fire to deal damage to enemies within range and enter Supernova state. While in Supernova state, Blazing Blast will transform into Flame Tornado, and Plasma Body's charges are replenished.

heroes.name: Doctor Strange
heroes.description: As the Sorcerer Supreme, Dr. Stephen Strange gracefully wields ancient spells to turn the tide of even the most impossible battle. However, magic always comes at a cost, and each use of his arcane abilities gradually awakens the darkness within him.

Teamup.name: GAMMA MAELSTROM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Maelstrom of Madness to Gamma Maelstrom. This drastically boosts energy charge rates and removes the Anti-Heal curse.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Gamma Maelstrom retains some energy, and stored Gamma energy doesn't decay over time.

Teamup.name: PSIONIC VORTEX
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Maelstrom of Madness to Psionic Vortex. Enemies caught in are Launched toward you. Shield of the Seraphim also gains increased shield value.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Invisible Woman, any damage dealt by Psionic Vortex provides proportional Bonus Health for Doctor Strange.

Teamup.name: CHAIN OF CYTTORAK
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Chain of Cyttorak can tether two enemies simultaneously, dragging both targets to the same location.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, Chain of Cyttorak can tether multiple enemies at once, pulling the entire group to a singular point.

Teamup.name: SORCERERS SUPREME
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cooldown-based ability. Chthonian Burst is replaced with Mystic Burst. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, this becomes a toggleable ability. Toggle to replace Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst.

ActiveAbilities.name: EYE OF AGAMOTTO
ActiveAbilities.text: Separate nearby enemies' Souls from their bodies. Damage dealt to these Souls is transferred to their physical bodies.

ActiveAbilities.name: DAGGERS OF DENAK
ActiveAbilities.text: Cast Daggers of Denak forward.

ActiveAbilities.name: PENTAGRAM OF FARALLAH
ActiveAbilities.text: Open portals between two locations, enabling all units to travel through them.

ActiveAbilities.name: SHIELD OF THE SERAPHIM
ActiveAbilities.text: Create a protective barrier against damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: MAELSTROM OF MADNESS
ActiveAbilities.text: Release Dark Magic to deal damage to nearby enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: CLOAK OF LEVITATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Ascend and then enter a brief state of sustained flight.

Passives.name: PRICE OF MAGIC
Passives.text: Dark Magic accumulates with every hit on an enemy. If Dark Magic peaks for too long, Doctor Strange will be cursed with Anti-Heal.

heroes.name: Mantis
heroes.description: Mantis uses her impressive mental abilities and her penchant for plant control to anchor any team she fights alongside. Her powers tap into a limitless flow of life energy, gently nourishing everything she touches.

Teamup.name: VIBRANT VITALITY
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Regeneration Domain provides a Damage Boost effect to allies within range; the Runestone triggers a psychic catalysis, expanding the domain's radius.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, deploying Regeneration Domain emits a shockwave of nature energy that damages enemies within the radius and slightly Launches them up.

Teamup.name: STAR BLOSSOM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Recasting Healing Flower on a teammate with the effect enhances and spreads the healing aura.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, using Healing Flower on any teammate instantly triggers the enhanced spell field and healing effect.

Teamup.name: VITALITY PACT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upon defeat, Mantis can freely move as a soul, healing nearby allies, and reforge her body at a chosen spot. After using Natural Anger, the effect of Nature's Favor is enhanced, increasing the amount of healing provided.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, her soul state can forge Soul Bond with nearby teammates, granting Healing Over Time and distributing damage taken across the bond.

Teamup.name: WILD WALL
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Summon a Wild Wall that provides Continuous Healing and Bonus Health to allies within its range.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, the Wild Wall evolves after providing a certain amount of healing, increasing its healing.

Teamup.name: SPIRIT BREAKER
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Damaging an enemy's sentience directly converts that damage into Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, shattering a sentience grants one-time Bonus Health while simultaneously reducing the cooldown of Psychic Spear.

ActiveAbilities.name: SOUL RESURGENCE
ActiveAbilities.text: Release energy around her while moving, providing Healing Over Time and Movement Boosts for surrounding allies. Excess healing converts to Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIFE ENERGY BLAST
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire an energy thorn and regain one Life Orb after a critical hit.

ActiveAbilities.name: HEALING FLOWER
ActiveAbilities.text: Consume Life Orbs to grant allies Healing Over Time.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPORE SLUMBER
ActiveAbilities.text: Throw a spore to Sedate the nearest enemy.

ActiveAbilities.name: ALLIED INSPIRATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Consume Life Orbs to grant allies a Damage and Speed Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: NATURAL ANGER
ActiveAbilities.text: Consume Life Orbs to grant herself a Damage Boost.

Passives.name: NATURE'S FAVOR
Passives.text: Receive a Movement Boost when not injured and Healing Over Time when consuming Life Orbs.

heroes.name: Hawkeye
heroes.description: Despite his lack of superpowers, Hawkeye's unparalleled skills as a marksman have earned him a spot alongside earth's mightiest heroes. With a cool head and steady hand, Clint Barton never misses a target… so enemies best stay out of his sights!

Teamup.name: MOONLIT SLASH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Crescent Slash to Moonlit Slash, projecting a radiant slash outward. It heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, Moonlit Slash can be chained into a three-hit combo, firing off three consecutive sweeping light blades.

Teamup.name: SENBONZAKURA STRIKE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Blast Arrow to Psionic Arrow. While drawn, Hawkeye can continuously bank extra Psionic Arrows. Releasing the bowstring fires all accumulated arrows forward simultaneously.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the nocking speed for each Psionic Arrow is significantly quickened, and they explode upon hitting enemies or the environment.

Teamup.name: ALLIED AGENTS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Landing hits with Red Room Rifle builds Focus. At three stacks, enter a Focused state where the next bullet gains the Hunter's Sight effect, granting Damage Boost and pierce effects.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hawkeye, landing a critical hit prevents the Focused state from expiring, allowing continuous enhanced fire until missing a crit.

ActiveAbilities.name: SKYWARD LEAP
ActiveAbilities.text: Perform a double jump in the direction of movement.

ActiveAbilities.name: PIERCING ARROW
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot a powerful arrow.

ActiveAbilities.name: RONIN SLASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Swing the wakizashi to strike frontal enemies, deflecting all incoming projectiles.

ActiveAbilities.name: BLAST ARROW
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot three explosive arrows.

ActiveAbilities.name: HYPERSONIC ARROW
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot a Hypersonic Arrow, dealing two instances of damage to enemies in its path and inflicting them with Slow. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes.

ActiveAbilities.name: CRESCENT SLASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Unsheathe a katana and slash forward, Launching Up hit enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: HUNTER'S SIGHT
ActiveAbilities.text: Capture Afterimages of enemies in his view. Damage dealt to an Afterimage is transferred to the corresponding enemy.

Passives.name: ARCHER'S FOCUS
Passives.text: Aim at an enemy to improve focus, enhancing the damage inflicted by Piercing Arrow.

heroes.name: Captain America
heroes.description: Enhanced by the Super-Soldier Serum, Steven "Steve" Rogers uses his Vibranium shield and extensive combat training to confront any threat to justice. When Captain America rallies his troops, a wave of courage sweeps across the battlefield!

Teamup.name: SAVAGE SLAM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Leap high and smash the ground, dealing damage to enemies and reducing the cooldowns of other abilities based on remaining Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, the ground slam additionally applies Vulnerability to enemies hit.

Teamup.name: VOLTAIC UNION
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Modify Sentinel Strike into a Lightning Shield projectile. After landing two hits, Captain America launches the piercing Lightning Shield four times.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, the lightning energy imbued in the shield intensifies. Each hit from the Lightning Shield triggers an extra burst of damage in the surrounding area.

Teamup.name: STARS ALIGNED
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Captain America can leap directly to a teammate, providing Bonus Health to both himself and the ally, while redirecting a portion of their incoming damage to himself.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Winter Soldier, the duo can trigger a mutual rally. Upon confirmation, they charge at one another, slamming together to grant Bonus Health and Movement Speed to all nearby friends. The original effect remains; now additionally granting a Speed Boost to the targeted teammate.

Teamup.name: BLEED FOR BATTLE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: For every set amount of damage taken, Blade builds a stack of Bloodline Awakening. Also raises the overall stack cap.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, taking critical damage instantly triggers the Bloodline Awakening state, gaining bonus stacks while continuing to raise the overall stack cap.

ActiveAbilities.name: SENTINEL STRIKE
ActiveAbilities.text: Get up close to strike enemies. Landing the second hit enables a shield throw that can ricochet four times.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIVING LEGEND
ActiveAbilities.text: Raise the shield to deflect incoming Projectiles, sending them ricocheting in random directions.

ActiveAbilities.name: LEADING DASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Boost speed and enable Fearless Leap to leap into the air.

ActiveAbilities.name: SUPER-SOLDIER SLAM
ActiveAbilities.text: Slam down from the sky onto the targeted area, Launching Up enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: VIBRANIUM ENERGY SAW
ActiveAbilities.text: Hurl the energy-charged shield to strike enemies in a path.

ActiveAbilities.name: FREEDOM CHARGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Shield held high, carve a path forward, granting both himself and allies along the path continuous Bonus Health and Movement Boosts. Allies also gain Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration. Using Living Legend and Leading Dash while this ability is active can Launch Up enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIBERTY RUSH
ActiveAbilities.text: Raise the shield and charge forward.

heroes.name: Rocket Raccoon
heroes.description: Rocket may not look like a tech genius or an expert tactician, but anyone who's ever made his hit list has quickly regretted underestimating him. This savvy space soldier is equally eager to boost his teammates and to collect bounties on his foes.

Teamup.name: AMMO OVERLOAD
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Throw an Ammo Overload Device in the target direction. Upon entering the device's range, receive Faster Firing.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the device grants Infinite Ammo and Faster Firing.

Teamup.name: PLANET X PALS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Convert Bombard Mode to launch Thorny Spores. Upon impact, they deal continuous damage to enemies within the radius while healing and granting Bonus Health to allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, Rocket can ride on Groot's shoulders, and the active duration of the Thorny Spores field is extended.

Teamup.name: MAMMALIAN BOND
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Toss out a scattered batch of augmented Vitality Acorns. Acorns that hit the floor can be collected. Whether struck directly or picked up, teammates receive a burst of healing and global cooldown reduction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Squirrel Girl, the maximum charge count for this ability is increased.

Teamup.name: FANTASTIC AMPLIFIER
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Equips the Fantastic Amplifier. For the duration, Mister Fantastic's maximum Elasticity is increased, and he can actively enter Inflation State.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, Brainiac Bounce Launches hit enemies.

Teamup.name: ROCKET NETWORK
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Deploy an Armored Spider-Nest that periodically drops Spider-Drones and Armor Packs that grant Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the Armored Spider-Nest passively regenerates its own Health. Furthermore, Rocket's B.R.B. will generate Cyber-Webs, and spawn both Spider-Drones and Arachno-Mines.

ActiveAbilities.name: BOMBARD MODE
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire energy projectiles that deal damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: JETPACK DASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward.

ActiveAbilities.name: B.R.B.
ActiveAbilities.text: Deploy a Battle Rebirth Beacon that revives a fallen ally and periodically produces armor packs and rocket jet packs.

ActiveAbilities.name: C.Y.A.
ActiveAbilities.text: Deploy a Cosmic Yarn Amplifier that grants allies a Damage Boost, while continuously providing them with Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: REPAIR MODE
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot bouncing spheres to heal allies. Directly hitting an ally provides extra healing.

Passives.name: WILD CRAWL
Passives.text: Hold SPACE to run on a wall.

Passives.name: FLYING ACE
Passives.text: Hold SPACE to fall slowly.

heroes.name: Hela
heroes.description: As the Goddess of Death, Hela wields supreme control over the fallen souls residing in Hel. With a haunting whisper and a murder of crows, the queen of the underworld gracefully reaps the souls of her enemies without an ounce of mercy.

Teamup.name: VILLAIN'S ILLUSION
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to target fallen heroes (friend or foe), letting Loki assume their form for a set time (cannot cast their Ultimate Ability).
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, Loki's transformation lasts slightly longer. Furthermore, taking lethal damage while transformed or in his Ultimate Ability state will merely revert him back to Loki with some Health, preventing a KO.

Teamup.name: HEL TENDRILS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Replace Soul Drainer with Hel Tendrils. Upon hit, tendrils pull nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, Slowingenemies that try to escape.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Piercing Night fires a dense volley of symbiote-infused Nightsword Thorns. Each direct Nightsword Thorn hit restores a portion of Hela's Health.

Teamup.name: DEEP WRATH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Whenever Hela participates in a KO, an Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position. While an Undead Monstro is present, casting Piercing Night will command the Monstro to spit a Nightsword Thorn at the nearest enemy.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Namor, each attack during Goddess of Death spawns an Undead Monstro at the point of impact.

Teamup.name: RAGNAROK REBIRTH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Receiving fatal damage prevents immediate defeat, Thor gains a decaying pool of Bonus Health. If he participates in a KO during this time, he resurrects and recovers a small amount of Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, if either of them participates in a KO, Thor instantly revives, restoring Health equal to his remaining Bonus Health and gaining a Continuous Healing effect.

Teamup.name: CIRCLE OF LIFE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Psionic Detonation is replaced by Phoenix Netherfire, applying a Telekinetic Mark to the targeted location. Upon hitting, it triggers an initial small explosion that briefly Stuns enemies, followed by two larger explosions that apply a Healing Reduction effect. Every single blast inflicts Sparks onto the enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, every blast in the sequence applies multiple stacks of Sparks to enemies caught within.

Teamup.name: "HEL-YEAH, HONEY"
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health. Strategist gains additional healing when unleashing the undead energy.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

ActiveAbilities.name: NIGHTSWORD THORN
ActiveAbilities.text: Throw Nightsword Thorns.

ActiveAbilities.name: PIERCING NIGHT
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire multiple Nightsword Thorns that detonate after a delay.

ActiveAbilities.name: ASTRAL FLOCK
ActiveAbilities.text: Transform into a Nastrond Crow to enter free flight, press again to undo the transformation. Gain Bonus Health when the transformation ends.

ActiveAbilities.name: SOUL DRAINER
ActiveAbilities.text: Project an explosive Hel sphere to Stun nearby enemies and pull them into the blast zone.

ActiveAbilities.name: GODDESS OF DEATH
ActiveAbilities.text: Soar into the sky and unleash Nastrond Crows from each hand at will.

Passives.name: NASTROND CROWSTORM
Passives.text: Defeating an enemy will generate a Nastrond Crow, exploding after a duration.

Passives.name: HEL'S DESCENT
Passives.text: HOLD SPACE to fall slowly.

heroes.name: Cloak & Dagger
heroes.description: Tyrone Johnson and Tandy Bowen are nearly inseparable, like two sides of the same coin. Intertwined by forces of shadow and light, Cloak & Dagger fight as a united front, dealing havoc and healing allies across the arena.

Teamup.name: MOONLIT SLASH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Crescent Slash to Moonlit Slash, projecting a radiant slash outward. It heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, Moonlit Slash can be chained into a three-hit combo, firing off three consecutive sweeping light blades.

Teamup.name: OBLIVION SHROUD
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Veil of Lightforce and Terror Cape are warped by void magic, changing into Twilight Veil and Void Veil while retaining their original effects, after traveling a set distance, the veils halt in place. Enemy damage passing through the Twilight Veil is weakened, while enemy healing passing through the Void Veil suffers Healing Reduction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the width of both the Twilight Veil and Void Veil expands. Additionally, allies passing through the veils are empowered by hellfire energy, gaining Damage Boost for a duration.

Teamup.name: FROZEN HAVEN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Channel frost energy outward to encase yourself in an absolute block of ice. This offers great protection, but Freezes you in place. While frozen, you can be healed and emit a weak healing aura to nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the healing aura provided to allies while Frozen becomes significantly stronger.

Teamup.name: LUMINOUS MOON
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Enter Phased state and dash forward while emitting a Light Energy Healing Wave that heals Moon Knight and nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, the Phased state duration is extended and the dash distance increases. Upon ending, Moon Knight gains Continuous Healing, while the radius of the Light Energy Healing Wave is expanded and its healing output increased.

Teamup.name: LIGHT & DARK DARTS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a ring of Light Darts in all directions that damage enemies and restore Psylocke's Health upon impact, leaving behind a Shadow Domain. Staying inside the domain for a short time will re-enter Stealth.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, the radius of the Shadow Domain expands, and each time re-entering Stealth, the Light Darts are fired in all directions again.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIGHTFORCE DAGGER
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash a bouncing Lightforce Dagger to damage enemies and heal nearby allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: DAGGER STORM
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a volley of daggers, creating a Healing-Over-Time field in the impact area. Allies in the area gain One-Time Healing when the field appears.

ActiveAbilities.name: SHADOW'S EMBRACE
ActiveAbilities.text: Switch to Cloak.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIGHT EXPLOSION
ActiveAbilities.text: Deploy a Veil of Lightforce to heal allies upon touch and grant them a Healing Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: DARKFORCE CLOAK
ActiveAbilities.text: Inflict continuous damage to an enemy.

ActiveAbilities.name: DARK TELEPORTATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Enshroud nearby allies in the Darkforce Dimension and grant them Phased, making them untargetable and invisible to enemies and granting them a Movement Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: TERROR CAPE
ActiveAbilities.text: Deploy a Veil of Darkforce to damage enemies upon touch, applying Blind to narrow their sight and Vulnerability to amplify damage received.

ActiveAbilities.name: ETERNAL BOND
ActiveAbilities.text: Perform four rapid dashes, healing allies and damaging enemies along the path.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIGHT'S EMBRACE
ActiveAbilities.text: Switch to Dagger.

heroes.name: Black Panther
heroes.description: T'Challa, King of Wakanda, wields the perfect blend of the cutting-edge Vibranium technology and ancestral power drawn from the Panther God, Bast. The Black Panther bides his time until elegantly infiltrating enemy lines and commencing his hunt.

Teamup.name: DAMISA-YAO
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Trigger the elemental power stored within his armor, dealing damage and applying Slow to surrounding enemies while attaching Vibranium Marks.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, enemies within range are launched toward Black Panther.

Teamup.name: DIMENSIONAL SHORTCUT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activate a Limbo stepping disc to instantly return to your position from a few seconds ago, gaining Bonus Health in the process. When the teleport ends, the disc collapses in an explosion, damaging nearby enemies and applying Vibranium Marks.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magik, the teleportation sequence can be manually canceled mid-transit.

Teamup.name: VIBRANIUM MECH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upon activation, deploy a frontal Vibranium Shield while Cyber-Web Cluster gains an Attack Speed Boost for a set duration.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, the Vibranium Shield is expanded, and its active time increased.

Teamup.name: FELINE ALLIANCE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Taking damage accumulates Vibranium Energy. Upon reaching a specific threshold, Black Cat can unleash a violent explosion, damaging and Knocking back surrounding enemies while gaining a brief Speed Boost and Bonus Health. For every enemy hit, gain 50 Fortune, up to a max of 100.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, this explosion is no longer restricted by the Vibranium Energy threshold and can be triggered at any time.

ActiveAbilities.name: SUBTLE STEP
ActiveAbilities.text: HOLD SPACE to run on a wall; perform a jump after detaching from the wall.

ActiveAbilities.name: VIBRANIUM CLAWS
ActiveAbilities.text: Slice Vibranium Claws forward.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPINNING KICK
ActiveAbilities.text: Spiral forward and attach a Vibranium Mark to hit enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPEAR TOSS
ActiveAbilities.text: Toss a Vibranium energy spear forward, creating a Vibranium Force Field and attaching a Vibranium Mark to enemies in its radius.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPIRIT REND
ActiveAbilities.text: Lunge forward and deal damage to enemies. Vibranium Mark produces Bonus Health and refreshes the ability.

ActiveAbilities.name: BAST'S DESCENT
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon Bast, pouncing forward, dealing damage and attaching a Vibranium Mark to hit enemies, while refreshing Spirit Rend. Gain Damage Reduction while summoning.

Passives.name: PANTHER'S CUNNING
Passives.text: Deal higher damage when at low Health.

heroes.name: Groot
heroes.description: A flora colossus from Planet X, the alien known as Groot exhibits enhanced vitality and the ability to manipulate all forms of vegetation. As sturdy as a towering tree, Groot forges his own way, serving as the team's silent but reliable pathfinder.

Teamup.name: PLANET X PALS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Convert Bombard Mode to launch Thorny Spores. Upon impact, they deal continuous damage to enemies within the radius while healing and granting Bonus Health to allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, Rocket can ride on Groot's shoulders, and the active duration of the Thorny Spores field is extended.

Teamup.name: WILD WALL
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Summon a Wild Wall that provides Continuous Healing and Bonus Health to allies within its range.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, the Wild Wall evolves after providing a certain amount of healing, increasing its healing.

Teamup.name: BUBBLE BUDDIES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Retreat inside a Bubble Shield to enter an Invincible state, granting self-targeted Continuous Healing.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, the healing effect inside the bubble is enhanced, and any excess healing converts into Bonus Health.

Teamup.name: FLORA MUNITIONS
Teamup.text:
Gain a new ability to toss Twisted Thorn Seeds forward. Upon landing, they rapidly Sprout and take root, generating Thorn Snares around the area. Enemies stepping on a snare take damage and suffer a Root effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, the number of Thorn Snares deployed increases, and the damage dealt when an enemy steps on them is boosted.

ActiveAbilities.name: STRANGLING PRISON
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a massive vine cluster that pulls nearby enemies to its center and Imprisons them.

ActiveAbilities.name: VINE STRIKE
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch vines to attack enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPORE BOMB
ActiveAbilities.text: Throw an explosive Spore Bomb that splits into multiple small explosive spores.

ActiveAbilities.name: THORNLASH WALL
ActiveAbilities.text: Target a location and grow a Thornlash Wall. When Awakened, it strikes nearby enemies attacked by Groot and his allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: IRONWOOD WALL
ActiveAbilities.text: Target a location and grow an Ironwood Wall. When the wall is Awakened, damage dealt by Groot and nearby allies grants Groot Bonus Health. Groot gains Unstoppable while near Ironwood Walls.

ActiveAbilities.name: FURIOUS FLORA
ActiveAbilities.text: Perform a combo with his arms, and the third strike will slightly Launch Up the hit enemy airborne.

Passives.name: FLORA COLOSSUS
Passives.text: Wooden walls near Groot will Awaken, activating an extra effect. Press LCLICK while building a wooden wall to continue building additional walls.

heroes.name: Ultron
heroes.description: The pinnacle of artificial lifeforms, Ultron is programmed to learn and adapt in ways far beyond human capability. He can summon an army of automated drones that obey his every command, raising his chances of victory exponentially.

Teamup.name: STARK PROTOCOL
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Encephalo-Ray to Nano-Ray, firing multiple nano-projectiles forward that damage enemies and heal allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, Imperative: Firewall fires powerful homing missiles at enemies in range, causing area damage.

Teamup.name: SP//DR SYNC
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Apply Imperative: Patch to all allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Imperative: Firewall applies to all Drones, allowing the ability effects to be triggered multiple times simultaneously.

Teamup.name: FLAWLESS DESIGN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cosmic Cluster now provides healing to allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Ultron, Cosmic Cluster creates an explosion upon impact.

ActiveAbilities.name: ENCEPHALO-RAY
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash a burning energy beam.

ActiveAbilities.name: IMPERATIVE: FIREWALL
ActiveAbilities.text: Deploy drones to an ally marked by Imperative: Patch, granting them increased Speed and Damage. Additionally, all allies within range of you and the chosen teammate receive Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: DYNAMIC FLIGHT
ActiveAbilities.text: Fly quickly in the direction of movement and then enter an Accelerated state.

ActiveAbilities.name: IMPERATIVE: PATCH
ActiveAbilities.text: Command up to 2 giant drones to follow 2 allies, constantly healing allies within its radius, with more healing for the designated allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: RAGE OF ULTRON
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon Ultron Drones to fire Encephalo-Rays, damaging enemies or healing allies. Deals enhanced damage against Bonus Health.

heroes.name: Magik
heroes.description: Trained in dark arts and wielding her mighty Soulsword, Magik leaps through portals to navigate the arena with ease. Once Illyana transforms into the demonic Darkchild, all those who dare stand against her will fall before her merciless blade.

Teamup.name: DIMENSIONAL SHORTCUT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activate a Limbo stepping disc to instantly return to your position from a few seconds ago, gaining Bonus Health in the process. When the teleport ends, the disc collapses in an explosion, damaging nearby enemies and applying Vibranium Marks.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magik, the teleportation sequence can be manually canceled mid-transit.

Teamup.name: CHAIN OF CYTTORAK
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Chain of Cyttorak can tether two enemies simultaneously, dragging both targets to the same location.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, Chain of Cyttorak can tether multiple enemies at once, pulling the entire group to a singular point.

Teamup.name: VOID PENTAGRAM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Casting Stepping Discs within an Void Magic Circle refunds energy, and each use of Stepping Discs summons a Limbo Demon.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the summoned Limbo Demons have heavily increased Health and a wider attack range.

ActiveAbilities.name: SOULSWORD
ActiveAbilities.text: Slash forward with the Soulsword.

ActiveAbilities.name: MAGIK SLASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Strike forward an air slash. Each enemy hit reduces the cooldown of Stepping Discs.

ActiveAbilities.name: STEPPING DISCS
ActiveAbilities.text: Jump through a Stepping Disc, teleporting a short distance in the direction of movement. Become Invincible while teleporting.

ActiveAbilities.name: ELDRITCH WHIRL
ActiveAbilities.text: Spin while swinging the Soulsword after exiting a Stepping Disc.

ActiveAbilities.name: DEMON'S RAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon a Limbo demon that attacks enemies after exiting a Stepping Disc.

ActiveAbilities.name: UMBRAL INCURSION
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward and Launch Up enemies airborne.

ActiveAbilities.name: DARKCHILD
ActiveAbilities.text: Transform into Darkchild, gaining enhancements to all her abilities.

ActiveAbilities.name: SOULSWORD
ActiveAbilities.text: Slash forward with the Soulsword.

ActiveAbilities.name: MAGIK SLASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Strike forward an air slash. Each enemy hit reduces the cooldown of Stepping Discs.

ActiveAbilities.name: STEPPING DISCS
ActiveAbilities.text: Jump through a Stepping Disc, teleporting a short distance in the direction of movement. Become Invincible while teleporting.

ActiveAbilities.name: ELDRITCH WHIRL
ActiveAbilities.text: Spin while swinging the Soulsword after exiting a Stepping Disc.

ActiveAbilities.name: DEMON'S RAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon a Limbo demon that attacks enemies after exiting a Stepping Disc.

ActiveAbilities.name: UMBRAL INCURSION
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward and Launch Up enemies airborne.

Passives.name: LIMBO'S MIGHT
Passives.text: Convert damage inflicted on enemies into Bonus Health to herself.

heroes.name: Moon Knight
heroes.description: As the avatar of the Egyptian God of Vengeance, Marc Spector's body has been enhanced by Khonshu himself. Bathed in a luminous aura that pierces the darkness, Moon Knight glides through the night, ready to sear his enemies with his master's sacred Ankhs.

Teamup.name: LUMINOUS MOON
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Enter Phased state and dash forward while emitting a Light Energy Healing Wave that heals Moon Knight and nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, the Phased state duration is extended and the dash distance increases. Upon ending, Moon Knight gains Continuous Healing, while the radius of the Light Energy Healing Wave is expanded and its healing output increased.

Teamup.name: BLOOD MOON
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Deploy an Ankh Trap. Upon triggering, an Ankh materializes at the location, while summoning a single Talon of Khonshu to Launch enemies toward the trap's center.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, triggering the trap summons multiple Talons of Khonshu to bombard the area.

Teamup.name: BLADE OF KHONSHU
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Perform a heavy forward cleave with the Ancestral Sword while performing a short dash. At the end of the dash, swiftly slash four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Moon Knight, each Whirlwind Slash triggered generates one additional Darkmoon Blade.

ActiveAbilities.name: CRESCENT DART
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash Crescent Darts forward that can bounce between enemies and Ankhs, dealing damage to enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: MOON BLADE
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch forward a Moon Blade that can bounce between enemies and Ankhs, dealing damage to enemies while granting you Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: ANCIENT ANKH
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire an Ankh to Knock enemies within its radius airborne towards the center.

ActiveAbilities.name: MOONLIGHT HOOK
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a frontal grappling hook that pulls Moon Knight towards it.

ActiveAbilities.name: NIGHT GLIDER
ActiveAbilities.text: Enter a gliding state.

ActiveAbilities.name: RISING LEAP
ActiveAbilities.text: Perform a double jump.

ActiveAbilities.name: HAND OF KHONSHU
ActiveAbilities.text: Open a portal that allows Khonshu to bombard enemies with his talons.

ActiveAbilities.name: TRIPLE ECLIPSE
ActiveAbilities.text: Perform a combo with his truncheon, and the third strike will slightly Launch Up enemies.

heroes.name: Luna Snow
heroes.description: Equal parts pop star and Super Hero, Luna Snow puts on a dazzling show with both her light and dark ice powers. The arena is her stage, where Seol Hee and her team orchestrate spectacular displays that earn her an ever-increasing number of fans and wins.

Teamup.name: FROZEN HAVEN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Channel frost energy outward to encase yourself in an absolute block of ice. This offers great protection, but Freezes you in place. While frozen, you can be healed and emit a weak healing aura to nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the healing aura provided to allies while Frozen becomes significantly stronger.

Teamup.name: ATLAS BOND
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a spirit fox forward that Charmsenemies while healing any allies in its path.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with White Fox, the spirit fox automatically returns after reaching its maximum distance.

Teamup.name: DUALITY DANCE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cast Soul Bond to tether all characters within range. Attacking tethered enemies or healing linked allies restores your Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, scoring critical hits with Light & Dark Ice reduces the cooldowns of Absolute Zero and Ice Arts.

Teamup.name: CHILLING CHARISMA
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to summon a Frost Tide forward. The wave damages, Pushes Back, and inflicts a Slow on all enemies hit. Additionally, Monstro Spawns are replaced by Frozen Spawns, which apply a Slow to enemies they hit.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the Frost Tide gains 1 charge and crashes down upon reaching its maximum range, dealing area damage and Slowing enemies caught near the endpoint.

Teamup.name: ICED OUT DIAMOND
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. In diamond form, condense frost into an Absolute Zero Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, entering Diamond Form imbues all damaging abilities with a Slow effect. Telepathic Pulse will also inflict a Slow effect.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIGHT & DARK ICE
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire ice shots that damage enemies or heal allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: ICE ARTS
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire ice shards for a short duration, damaging enemies or healing allies while restoring her own Health. Participating in a KO reduces the cooldown of Ice Arts.

ActiveAbilities.name: ABSOLUTE ZERO
ActiveAbilities.text: Cast a clump of ice to Freeze the hit enemy and restore Health. Landing a hit grants Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: SHARE THE STAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Attach Idol Aura to an ally. Allies with Idol Aura also restore Health when Luna Snow is healing others.

ActiveAbilities.name: FATE OF BOTH WORLDS
ActiveAbilities.text: Take center stage and start dancing! Toggle between two performances: Heal allies or grant them Damage Boost.

Passives.name: NUMBER ONE IDOL
Passives.text: Boost Healing for self. Gain extra self healing when healing others.

Passives.name: SMOOTH SKATE
Passives.text: Keep moving forward to start ice skating and enable higher jumps.

Passives.name: CRYO HEART
Passives.text: Automatically restore Health when casting Ice Arts or Absolute Zero.

heroes.name: Squirrel Girl
heroes.description: Possessing only the powers of a common squirrel, somehow Doreen Green manages to defeat seemingly invincible enemies in the most unexpected ways. Any foe who counts her out is bound to fall at the hands of the Unbeatable Squirrel Girl!

Teamup.name: MAMMALIAN BOND
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Toss out a scattered batch of augmented Vitality Acorns. Acorns that hit the floor can be collected. Whether struck directly or picked up, teammates receive a burst of healing and global cooldown reduction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Squirrel Girl, the maximum charge count for this ability is increased.

Teamup.name: SQUIRREL MISSILE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain the Squirrel Missile ability. Squirrel Girl directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, using Squirrel Blockade simultaneously fires a Squirrel Missile.

Teamup.name: ESU ALUMNUS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Spider-Man gives Squirrel Girl a web bomb. She can launch it to unleash an explosion upon contact with the environment or an enemy, briefly Slowing and damaging enemies caught in the blast. It simultaneously generates a Web Area that applies a Grounded effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, Squirrel Girl receives more Web Fluid. After throwing Webbed Acorn, viscous web fluid coats the ground alongside the explosion, leaving behind a sticky Web Area. Enemies within suffer continuous Slow and Grounded effects that scale into a Stun if they linger too long.

ActiveAbilities.name: BURST ACORN
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot bouncing Burst Acorns.

ActiveAbilities.name: TAIL BOUNCE
ActiveAbilities.text: Rocket upwards with a bounce of her tail.

ActiveAbilities.name: MAMMAL BOND
ActiveAbilities.text: Reload Burst Acorns and can use an ability without cooldown once in a short duration.

ActiveAbilities.name: SQUIRREL BLOCKADE
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch an acorn to unleash Squirrel Guards, Imprisoning the first hit enemy.

ActiveAbilities.name: UNBEATABLE SQUIRREL TSUNAMI
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon a horde of squirrels to charge forward, dealing damage while bouncing against structures.

heroes.name: Black Widow
heroes.description: Natasha Romanova is the world's most elite spy in any era. Her mastery of the sniper rifle eliminates targets from afar, while her shock batons neutralize close-range threats. Black Widow is locked, loaded, and ready to deliver a fatal bite!

Teamup.name: ALLIED AGENTS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Landing hits with Red Room Rifle builds Focus. At three stacks, enter a Focused state where the next bullet gains the Hunter's Sight effect, granting Damage Boost and pierce effects.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hawkeye, landing a critical hit prevents the Focused state from expiring, allowing continuous enhanced fire until missing a crit.

Teamup.name: BURNING BULLETS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activation grants the Red Room Rifle a Fire Rate Boost. Additionally, the Plasma Cannon projectile becomes a hitscan laser that no longer requires charging.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, her Plasma Cannon gains a second ability charge.

Teamup.name: DEVILISH AFFAIR
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Swings Devil's Chain in a criss-cross pattern, dealing damage to enemies in front and inflicting a Slow. 
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Widow, the damage radius is expanded, and landing hits recovers Fury.

ActiveAbilities.name: EDGE DANCER
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash a spinning kick to Launch Up enemies. Landing the hit will allow her to zip to the target with a grappling hook for a second kick.

ActiveAbilities.name: ASSASSIN'S FOCUS
ActiveAbilities.text: Switch the Red Room Rifle to sniper mode. Shots fired in this state pierce through targets and deal increased damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: FLEET FOOT
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward and enable a powerful jump.

ActiveAbilities.name: RED ROOM RIFLE
ActiveAbilities.text: Attack with the Red Room Rifle.

ActiveAbilities.name: WIDOW'S BITE SLAM
ActiveAbilities.text: Leap toward a target area and slam the ground with her Widow's Bite gauntlet, dealing damage to enemies within range.

ActiveAbilities.name: ELECTRO-PLASMA BLAST
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire an electro-plasma round forward. Upon hitting the environment or an enemy, it explodes and applies a Slow effect.

ActiveAbilities.name: ELECTRIC BATONS
ActiveAbilities.text: Strike with the enhanced electric batons.

heroes.name: Iron Man
heroes.description: Armed with superior intellect and a nanotech battlesuit of his own design, Tony Stark stands alongside gods as the Invincible Iron Man. His state of the art armor turns any battlefield into his personal playground, allowing him to steal the spotlight he so desperately desires.

Teamup.name: STARK PROTOCOL
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Encephalo-Ray to Nano-Ray, firing multiple nano-projectiles forward that damage enemies and heal allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, Imperative: Firewall fires powerful homing missiles at enemies in range, causing area damage.

Teamup.name: SQUIRREL MISSILE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain the Squirrel Missile ability. Squirrel Girl directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, using Squirrel Blockade simultaneously fires a Squirrel Missile.

Teamup.name: GAMMA CHARGE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Armor Overdrive to Gamma Overdrive. In this state, Iron Man gains a Gamma Shield and can fire stronger Repulsor Blasts and Unibeams.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Invincible Invincible Pulse Cannon generates a Gamma Shield and heavily infuses the blast, creating a Gamma Pulse Cannon. Its radiation creates a damage increase while the projectile flies.

Teamup.name: THUNDER OVERDRIVE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Enhance Unibeam both in and out of Armor Overdrive. When fired, a ring of volatile lightning energy forms, dealing bonus damage to enemies caught near the beam's edge.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, Armor Overdrive cooldown is massively reduced.

ActiveAbilities.name: REPULSOR BLAST
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire nano pulse cannons forward.

ActiveAbilities.name: UNIBEAM
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a unibeam forward.

ActiveAbilities.name: HYPER-VELOCITY
ActiveAbilities.text: Activate Hyper-Velocity state for swift forward flight.

ActiveAbilities.name: MICRO-MISSILE BARRAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: When Hyper-Velocity or Armor Overdrive is used, Iron Man can launch a missile bombardment.

ActiveAbilities.name: ARMOR OVERDRIVE
ActiveAbilities.text: Activate Armor Overdrive state, enhancing damage of Repulsor Blast and Unibeam, while also granting Bonus Health. Participating in a KO increases the active time of Armor Overdrive.

ActiveAbilities.name: INVINCIBLE PULSE CANNON
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a devastating pulse cannon in the targeted direction, delivering catastrophic damage to the targeted area upon impact.

heroes.name: Venom
heroes.description: Using his symbiote-enhanced body as the perfect living weapon, Eddie Brock and his alien ally stand ever-ready to unleash vicious attacks upon anyone he deems an enemy. Those ensnared by Venom's tentacles have no choice but to surrender to this insatiable predator.

Teamup.name: HEL TENDRILS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Replace Soul Drainer with Hel Tendrils. Upon hit, tendrils pull nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, Slowingenemies that try to escape.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Piercing Night fires a dense volley of symbiote-infused Nightsword Thorns. Each direct Nightsword Thorn hit restores a portion of Hela's Health.

Teamup.name: BLOOD LEECH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cellular Corrosion new effect: while tethered to enemies, continuously siphon health from every linked target, restoring Venom's Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, Venom gains a burst of one-time healing when using certain specific abilities.

Teamup.name: ABYSSAL FLAMES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Ignite the symbiote with Phoenix Flames for a duration, replacing Dark Predation with a sweeping Avian Claw frontal slash.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Venom's Phoenix Force is enhanced: every Avian Claw applies a Spark. Upon reaching three stacks, the Sparks detonate.

Teamup.name: SYMBIOTE BOND
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Venom shares a part of his symbiote with Spider-Man, activating their symbiote abilities. Spider-Man can convert the symbiotes into explosive spikes that inflict harm on nearby enemies and relentlessly drive them back.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, this triggers additional Touch of Klyntar tendrils that continuously tether and damage enemies on top of the base effect.

Teamup.name: GUARDIAN OF THE DEEP
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Shoot out healing tendrils; linked allies receive Continuous Healing, and excess healing is converted into Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, symbiote tendrils can also lash out at nearby enemies within range, inflicting continuous damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: DARK PREDATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash tentacles forward to attack enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: FRENZIED ARRIVAL
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash to the target location from a certain height. Upon landing, damage nearby enemies, Launching Them Up towards the landing point.

ActiveAbilities.name: CELLULAR CORROSION
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash tentacles to Slow enemies within reach. Enemies unable to break free in time will suffer damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: VENOM SWING
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch webbing forward, allowing for a singular swing in the desired direction.

ActiveAbilities.name: SYMBIOTIC RESILIENCE
ActiveAbilities.text: Generate Bonus Health against damage. The lower Venom's Health, the greater the Bonus Health generated.

ActiveAbilities.name: FEAST OF THE ABYSS
ActiveAbilities.text: Burrow underground for free movement. After a duration or by pressing LCLICK, devour enemies above to deal damage based on the enemy's current health and generate equivalent Bonus Health. Devoured enemies suffer Reduced Healing.

Passives.name: ALIEN BIOLOGY
Passives.text: PRESSSPACE to wall crawl, and while crawling, PRESSLCLICKto sprint.

heroes.name: Spider-man
heroes.description: Swinging around the arena on his signature weblines, your friendly neighborhood Spider-Man, AKA Peter Parker, catches his rivals by surprise with sneaky, sticky bursts of webbing and unexpected attacks from above. Look out... here comes the Spider-Man!

Teamup.name: ESU ALUMNUS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Spider-Man gives Squirrel Girl a web bomb. She can launch it to unleash an explosion upon contact with the environment or an enemy, briefly Slowing and damaging enemies caught in the blast. It simultaneously generates a Web Area that applies a Grounded effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, Squirrel Girl receives more Web Fluid. After throwing Webbed Acorn, viscous web fluid coats the ground alongside the explosion, leaving behind a sticky Web Area. Enemies within suffer continuous Slow and Grounded effects that scale into a Stun if they linger too long.

Teamup.name: SYMBIOTE BOND
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Venom shares a part of his symbiote with Spider-Man, activating their symbiote abilities. Spider-Man can convert the symbiotes into explosive spikes that inflict harm on nearby enemies and relentlessly drive them back.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, this triggers additional Touch of Klyntar tendrils that continuously tether and damage enemies on top of the base effect.

Teamup.name: PARKER POWER-UP
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Spider-Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging all Web-Cluster shots.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Spider-Tracers applied by Web-Cluster are upgraded. Detonating these upgraded marks generates Bonus Health for Spider-Man.

Teamup.name: BINDING TIES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Turn of Fortune is replaced by Spider-Web Grapple, which has 2 charges. Landing the grapple on an enemy steals Fortune and applies a Spider-Tracer. If Black Cat hits an enemy carrying a Spider-Tracer with any other ability, she triggers the mark to deal bonus damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, using Spider-Web Grapple to hit an enemy already marked with a Spider-Tracer temporarily Immobilizes them in place.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPIDER-POWER
ActiveAbilities.text: Swing fists forward to strike, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer.

ActiveAbilities.name: WEB-CLUSTER
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot a Web-Cluster that deals damage and attaches a Spider-Tracer to the hit enemy.

ActiveAbilities.name: GET OVER HERE!
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot webbing to reel in the hit enemy. If the enemy is tagged with a Spider-Tracer, Spider-Man will get pulled to them instead.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPECTACULAR SPIN
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch Web-Clusters all around to damage and Stun enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: WEB-SWING
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot a strand of webbing to swing.

ActiveAbilities.name: WALL CRAWL
ActiveAbilities.text: PRESS SPACE to crawl on vertical surfaces, and PRESS LCLICK to run on them.

ActiveAbilities.name: AMAZING COMBO
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch an enemy upward, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer.

Passives.name: THWIP AND FLIP
Passives.text: Perform a double jump.

Passives.name: SPIDER-SENSE
Passives.text: Give a warning of enemies that have been around.

heroes.name: Magneto
heroes.description: The Master of Magnetism bends even the strongest metal to his whims, shielding his allies and striking at his foes. Whether he calls himself Max Eisenhardt, Erik Lehnsherr, or simply Magneto, the hardships this warrior has endured have made him as unbreakable as the steel he brandishes.

Teamup.name: METALLIC CHAOS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Swing a colossal Chaos Greatsword forward to inflict damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Scarlet Witch, Mag-Cannon transforms into a charged ability that consumes his passive energy bar. For every tick of energy burned, a Chaos Greatsword is fired, dealing damage to enemies and inflicting a Launch Up effect.

Teamup.name: MAGNETIC RESONANCE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cast a magnetic projection that mimics Magneto's movement and ability casts perfectly from the enemy's perspective.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, the magnetic projection receives a massive Health bump and will persist indefinitely unless destroyed or manually recalled.

Teamup.name: FAVORABLE ODDS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Throw two magnetic playing cards forward. Upon hitting the environment or a character, the cards magnetically repel and unfurl, spinning in place for a duration. They heal allies they hit, while damaging and Launching enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, after the duration ends, the magnetic poles of the cards reverse. They violently slam back together and explode, providing an extra burst of healing to allies and damage to enemies.

Teamup.name: EXPLOSIVE ENTANGLEMENT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Defensive Stance is fortified. Activating the ability expands a magnetic field, drastically boosting the Damage Reduction ratio of Defensive Stance. Furthermore, all damage absorbed by the field is converted directly into damage for Southern Brawl.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, Southern Brawl Knocks back enemies. Extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall.

ActiveAbilities.name: IRON VOLLEY
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a volley of magnetic orbs forward. The range of the resulting explosion increases based on distance flown.

ActiveAbilities.name: MAG-CANNON
ActiveAbilities.text: Convert the iron rings on Magneto's back into a Mag-Cannon and launch a metallic mass forward. Higher stacks of rings increase damage, and full stacks Knock Back enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: METALLIC CURTAIN
ActiveAbilities.text: Change the magnetic field around to form a metallic curtain, blocking all incoming Projectiles.

ActiveAbilities.name: METAL BULWARK
ActiveAbilities.text: Conjure a metal shield around a chosen ally. Damage taken will transform into rings on Magneto's back.

ActiveAbilities.name: METEOR M
ActiveAbilities.text: Draw in all materials around to forge an iron meteor that deals massive damage upon impact. Absorbing enemy Projectiles can enhance the meteor's power, yet overloading will cause it to self-destruct.

ActiveAbilities.name: IRON BULWARK
ActiveAbilities.text: Conjure an iron shield around himself. Damage taken will transform into rings on Magneto's back.

Passives.name: MAGNETIC DESCENT
Passives.text: Hold SPACE to fall slowly.

heroes.name: Scarlet Witch
heroes.description: Wanda Maximoff is adept at harnessing formidable chaos magic, casting hexes with the power to twist and reshape reality itself. Energy, space, and matter are mere playthings in the hands of Scarlet Witch!

Teamup.name: METALLIC CHAOS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Swing a colossal Chaos Greatsword forward to inflict damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Scarlet Witch, Mag-Cannon transforms into a charged ability that consumes his passive energy bar. For every tick of energy burned, a Chaos Greatsword is fired, dealing damage to enemies and inflicting a Launch Up effect.

Teamup.name: SORCERERS SUPREME
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cooldown-based ability. Chthonian Burst is replaced with Mystic Burst. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, this becomes a toggleable ability. Toggle to replace Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst.

Teamup.name: HEX FIREWORKS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Infuse firework energy into the Dark Seal forcefield, turning it into a Plasmoid Seal, allowing for a secondary blast. After expanding the Plasmoid Seal, pressing the SHIFT key again while it persists will detonate the fireworks, dealing damage and inflicting Vulnerability.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, Scarlet Witch receives constant healing from the firework energy while using Mystic Projection.

ActiveAbilities.name: TELEKINESIS
ActiveAbilities.text: HOLD SPACE to fall slowly.

ActiveAbilities.name: CHAOS CONTROL
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash Chaos Magic on enemies to deal damage and restore Chaos Energy. Concurrently damages any enemies within range bearing a Chaos Magic mark.

ActiveAbilities.name: CHTHONIAN BURST
ActiveAbilities.text: Consume Chaos Energy to fire explosive magic missiles, damaging enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: DARK SEAL
ActiveAbilities.text: Land a hit on a target or the scene, or press SHIFT again to generate a Force Field. The initial explosion Stuns enemies within range, while continuing to apply a Slow effect for the remaining duration. Continuously inflicts Chaos Marks on enemies within range.

ActiveAbilities.name: MYSTIC PROJECTION
ActiveAbilities.text: Enter the Phased state for free-flight. Press E to exit early.

ActiveAbilities.name: REALITY ERASURE
ActiveAbilities.text: Engage in free-flight while gaining Bonus Health and charging energy. While flying, continuously pull in nearby enemies and inflict Chaos Marks, dealing gradually increasing damage over time. Then, unleash the charged energy to deal massive area damage. Small chance to be immune to incoming damage from enemies within the ultimate's attack range.

ActiveAbilities.name: SCARLET HEX
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash a shockwave of Chaos Magic forward, dealing damage and applying a Chaos Magic mark to enemies.

Passives.name: CHAOS MARK
Passives.text: While the mark is active, using Chaos Control deals damage to marked enemies. Dealing damage to enemies with a Chaos Mark grants Bonus Health.

heroes.name: Thor
heroes.description: The son of Odin taps into his divine power to call forth thunder and lightning, raining down relentless fury upon his enemies. With his mighty hammer Mjölnir in hand, Thor effortlessly asserts his dominance on the field of combat.

Teamup.name: GODS OF THUNDER
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Wind Blade into a hitscan lightning beam that detonates upon striking a target.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor,Bolt Rush becomes Chain Lightning, allowing it to bounce from foe to foe.

Teamup.name: VOLTAIC UNION
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Modify Sentinel Strike into a Lightning Shield projectile. After landing two hits, Captain America launches the piercing Lightning Shield four times.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, the lightning energy imbued in the shield intensifies. Each hit from the Lightning Shield triggers an extra burst of damage in the surrounding area.

Teamup.name: THUNDER OVERDRIVE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Enhance Unibeam both in and out of Armor Overdrive. When fired, a ring of volatile lightning energy forms, dealing bonus damage to enemies caught near the beam's edge.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, Armor Overdrive cooldown is massively reduced.

Teamup.name: RAGNAROK REBIRTH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Receiving fatal damage prevents immediate defeat, Thor gains a decaying pool of Bonus Health. If he participates in a KO during this time, he resurrects and recovers a small amount of Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, if either of them participates in a KO, Thor instantly revives, restoring Health equal to his remaining Bonus Health and gaining a Continuous Healing effect.

Teamup.name: DIVINE ARMORY
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Angela, leaping to the Thunder Spear grants Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: MJÖLNIR BASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Wield Mjölnir to strike enemies. When Awakened, Thor can launch lightning arc waves to deal damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: HAMMER THROW
ActiveAbilities.text: Throw Mjolnir forward, which then returns. Restore Thorforce upon hit and gain Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIGHTNING REALM
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon lightning to restore Thorforce based on the number of hit enemies. Enemies leaving the Lightning Realm will suffer Slow and Grounded effects.

ActiveAbilities.name: STORM SURGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Hold to spin Mjölnir before dashing forward in the controlled direction, Knocking Back enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: AWAKENING RUNE
ActiveAbilities.text: Consume Thorforce to enter the Awakened state, granting Bonus Health and enhancing Mjölnir Bash. Gain Thorforce upon exiting the state.

ActiveAbilities.name: GOD OF THUNDER
ActiveAbilities.text: Soar upwards and smite the ground after charging for a duration, inflicting damage and stunning enemies within range.

Passives.name: THORFORCE
Passives.text: Consume Thorforce to gain Bonus Health. Landing Mjölnir Bash on an enemy instantly recharges Thorforce.

heroes.name: Mister Fantastic
heroes.description: Reed Richards believes that true strength comes from remaining flexible, both mentally and physically. Mister Fantastic's elastic body, which can twist and stretch into any form with ease, is almost as impressive as his brilliant mind.

Teamup.name: FANTASTIC AMPLIFIER
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Equips the Fantastic Amplifier. For the duration, Mister Fantastic's maximum Elasticity is increased, and he can actively enter Inflation State.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, Brainiac Bounce Launches hit enemies.

Teamup.name: CLOBBERIN' RESEARCH DEPT.
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Toggle Ability. In brawler stance, Stretch Punch becomes a charged ability, firing a forward Brawling Punch. Hitting an enemy grants Bonus Health scaling with damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Thing, while in the brawling stance, Distended Grip also becomes a charged ability, slamming down a Distended Hammer. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health based on damage, and a full charge Launches hit enemies.

Teamup.name: FIRST FAMILY
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Invisible Woman and surrounding allies enter Invisible state, gaining healing and a Speed Boost. The effect ends if they take damage or the duration expires. Disengaging from combat for a duration will reenter the Invisible state.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mister Fantastic, the healing and Speed Boost effects are enhanced, and the Invisible state duration is increased.

ActiveAbilities.name: STRETCH PUNCH
ActiveAbilities.text: Stretch out a forward punch to attack enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: DISTENDED GRIP
ActiveAbilities.text: Extend arms forward to entangle an enemy, then press LCLICK to pull the hit enemy toward you, or select and yank another enemy, knocking them airborne against each other. Hit targets are Immobilized.

ActiveAbilities.name: FLEXIBLE ELONGATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Gain a Shield, select a target, and dash towards them, dealing damage to enemies and granting a Shield to allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: REFLEXIVE RUBBER
ActiveAbilities.text: Stretch body to absorb damage before launching stored damage in the targeted direction.

ActiveAbilities.name: BRAINIAC BOUNCE
ActiveAbilities.text: Leap upward and smash the ground, slowing enemies within range. Can leap again upon landing a hit.

Passives.name: ELASTIC STRENGTH
Passives.text: Using abilities generates Elasticity. Reaching full Elasticity triggers an Inflated state that increases Maximum Health, boosts damage, and enables the use of Reflexive Rubber.

heroes.name: Winter Soldier
heroes.description: Terrifying experiments turned him into a brainwashed assassin, but now James "Bucky" Barnes is in control of his own fate once again. With his enhanced mechanical arm, the Winter Soldier is primed to deliver earth-shattering blows to any foe in his path!

Teamup.name: STARS ALIGNED
Teamup.text:
