Base Effect: Captain America can leap directly to a teammate, providing Bonus Health to both himself and the ally, while redirecting a portion of their incoming damage to himself.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Winter Soldier, the duo can trigger a mutual rally. Upon confirmation, they charge at one another, slamming together to grant Bonus Health and Movement Speed to all nearby friends. The original effect remains; now additionally granting a Speed Boost to the targeted teammate.

Teamup.name: TIMELESS VETERANS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unlocks the Burst Spike ability. Using the bionic arm emits forward electricity, dealing damage and Knocking Back enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the electric burst applies a Grounded effect and Knocks Back enemies even further.

Teamup.name: EXPERT INSTINCT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Securing or participating in a KO grants a stack of Culling Instinct. Each stack reduces the cooldowns of Winter Soldier's other abilities. Stacks are lost upon defeat.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, the Bonus Health generated by Ceaseless Charge is increased.

ActiveAbilities.name: ROTERSTERN
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire explosive rounds with his blaster, Roterstern, damaging the target hit and enemies behind them.

ActiveAbilities.name: BIONIC HOOK
ActiveAbilities.text: Charge up and launch a hook with his bionic arm, reeling in the first target hit and enemies lurking behind.

ActiveAbilities.name: TROOPER'S FIST
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward, seizing enemies along the path, and Launch Up enemies in front at the end of the dash.

ActiveAbilities.name: TAINTED VOLTAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Charge up and launch a powerful electrical punch with the bionic arm in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies within range and Slowing them. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes.

ActiveAbilities.name: KRAKEN IMPACT
ActiveAbilities.text: Leap high, then dash forward and slam down with the bionic arm, dealing damage to enemies in range, marking them for Culling. Marked enemies will perish instantly if their health falls below a certain threshold, recharging the bionic arm for another Kraken Impact within a short period.

Passives.name: CEASELESS CHARGE
Passives.text: Roterstern reloads automatically while the bionic arm is in action, granting the Winter Soldier Bonus Health.

heroes.name: Peni Parker
heroes.description: Peni Parker may be young, but she bravely stands on the frontlines to protect the Web of Life and Destiny. Together, this teen prodigy and her state-of-the-art mech, the sensational SP//dr, make for the most thrilling duo on the battlefield!

Teamup.name: SP//DR SYNC
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Apply Imperative: Patch to all allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Imperative: Firewall applies to all Drones, allowing the ability effects to be triggered multiple times simultaneously.

Teamup.name: PARKER POWER-UP
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Spider-Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging all Web-Cluster shots.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Spider-Tracers applied by Web-Cluster are upgraded. Detonating these upgraded marks generates Bonus Health for Spider-Man.

Teamup.name: VIBRANIUM MECH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upon activation, deploy a frontal Vibranium Shield while Cyber-Web Cluster gains an Attack Speed Boost for a set duration.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, the Vibranium Shield is expanded, and its active time increased.

Teamup.name: ROCKET NETWORK
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Deploy an Armored Spider-Nest that periodically drops Spider-Drones and Armor Packs that grant Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the Armored Spider-Nest passively regenerates its own Health. Furthermore, Rocket's B.R.B. will generate Cyber-Webs, and spawn both Spider-Drones and Arachno-Mines.

ActiveAbilities.name: WALL CRAWL
ActiveAbilities.text: HOLD SPACE to crawl on vertical surfaces.

ActiveAbilities.name: CYBER-WEB CLUSTER
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch forward a Cyber-Web Cluster.

ActiveAbilities.name: CYBER-WEB SNARE
ActiveAbilities.text: Cast futuristic webbing that inflicts a Web-Tracer and Slow on hit or creates a Cyber-Web. If it hits an enemy marked with a Web-Tracer, it Immobilizes them. In the Cyber-Web, Peni and allies gain a Movement Boost and Healing Over Time.

ActiveAbilities.name: BIONIC SPIDER-NEST
ActiveAbilities.text: Generate a Bionic Spider-Nest at a targeted area, periodically spawning Spider-Drones and creating Cyber-Webs. While in the Cyber-Web, Peni and allies gain Healing Over Time and a Movement Boost. Excess healing converts into Bonus Health. Spider-Drones inflict a Slow effect on hit, which can stack and refresh its effect period with multiple hits.

ActiveAbilities.name: ARACHNO-MINE
ActiveAbilities.text: Deploy Arachno-Mines that can be concealed within the confines of a Cyber-Web.

ActiveAbilities.name: CYBER-BOND
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot a web strand that links to the targeted area or Cyber-Web. If stretched too far, it will trigger a pullback.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPIDER-SWEEPER
ActiveAbilities.text: Enhance the SP//dr suit, Launching Up enemies in its path and deploying Arachno-Mines, Spider-Drones, and Cyber-Webs repeatedly. Spider-Drones inflict a Slow effect on hit, which can stack and refresh its effect period with multiple hits.

heroes.name: Star-lord
heroes.description: Peter Quill lives to dazzle his foes on the battlefield with his signature swagger. As his element guns paint arcs of devastation, his acrobatic moves sail through the sky with unrivaled style. With performances this spectacular, it's no wonder that Star-Lord is so legendary!

Teamup.name: STAR BLOSSOM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Recasting Healing Flower on a teammate with the effect enhances and spreads the healing aura.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, using Healing Flower on any teammate instantly triggers the enhanced spell field and healing effect.

Teamup.name: FLORA MUNITIONS
Teamup.text:
Gain a new ability to toss Twisted Thorn Seeds forward. Upon landing, they rapidly Sprout and take root, generating Thorn Snares around the area. Enemies stepping on a snare take damage and suffer a Root effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, the number of Thorn Snares deployed increases, and the damage dealt when an enemy steps on them is boosted.

Teamup.name: STAR-SOUL
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to place a Telekinetic Beacon. You can teleport back to the location where the beacon is deployed from anywhere on the map. Upon defeat, Star-Lord will cocoon and respawn at the Telekinetic Beacon's coordinates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, every time Star-Lord participates in a KO, Telekinetic Beaconcooldown is reduced.

Teamup.name: ASGARDIANS OF THE GALAXY
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activation grants Reveal within a targeted area. Activating the ability again performs a slam attack; enemies hit by the slam are Grounded.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, Angela gains Bonus Health scaling with the number of enemies struck by the slam.

ActiveAbilities.name: ELEMENT GUNS
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot enemies with dual Element Guns.

ActiveAbilities.name: STELLAR SHIFT
ActiveAbilities.text: Dodge in the direction of movement and swiftly reload. Become Unstoppable and Invincible while dodging.

ActiveAbilities.name: ROCKET PROPULSION
ActiveAbilities.text: Consume energy to gain a Movement Boost and soar forward.

ActiveAbilities.name: GALACTIC LEGEND
ActiveAbilities.text: Engage in free-flight and lock onto enemies in sight.

ActiveAbilities.name: BLASTER BARRAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a frenzy of shots, causing damage to enemies within range.

heroes.name: Blade
heroes.description: Half-human and half-vampire, Eric Brooks walks between worlds, craving the very life force of his enemies. As night falls, Blade's hunt begins as he wields the Sword of Dracula to become the nightmare of any foe who dares to bare their fangs.

Teamup.name: BLOOD LEECH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cellular Corrosion new effect: while tethered to enemies, continuously siphon health from every linked target, restoring Venom's Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, Venom gains a burst of one-time healing when using certain specific abilities.

Teamup.name: BLADE OF KHONSHU
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Perform a heavy forward cleave with the Ancestral Sword while performing a short dash. At the end of the dash, swiftly slash four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Moon Knight, each Whirlwind Slash triggered generates one additional Darkmoon Blade.

Teamup.name: BLEED FOR BATTLE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: For every set amount of damage taken, Blade builds a stack of Bloodline Awakening. Also raises the overall stack cap.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, taking critical damage instantly triggers the Bloodline Awakening state, gaining bonus stacks while continuing to raise the overall stack cap.

Teamup.name: VAMPIRIC KIN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Deploy a Vampiric Field. Allies standing within the field gain Life Steal when attacking enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, allies inside the field receive an additional Continuous Healing effect.

ActiveAbilities.name: THOUSAND-FOLD SLASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Charge power and swiftly draw the Sword of Dracula, executing a powerful Iaido strike as you dash forward, leaving behind a slashing zone where the sword automatically strikes enemies. Enemies hit suffer Reduced Healing.

ActiveAbilities.name: ANCESTRAL SWORD
ActiveAbilities.text: Slash forward with Blade's Ancestral Sword.

ActiveAbilities.name: HUNTER'S SHOTGUN
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire at enemies using your Shotgun.

ActiveAbilities.name: DAYWALKER DASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward. If wielding your gun, shoot at enemies upon impact, applying a Slow effect. If wielding your sword, deliver a cleaving strike that inflicts Healing Reduction.

ActiveAbilities.name: BLOODLINE AWAKENING
ActiveAbilities.text: Awaken the Dhampir bloodline, enhancing slash speed during continuous attacks and triggering Whirlwind Slash. If all Whirlwind Slash strikes hit, your Attack Speed will further increase. While under this state, you suffer Reduced Healing, but attacks gain Lifesteal. Excess lifesteal converts to Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: SCARLET SHROUD
ActiveAbilities.text: Parry with Ancestral Sword to become Unstoppable for a brief period, reducing damage taken from the front and decreasing the cooldown of Daywalker Dash.

heroes.name: Namor
heroes.description: The unrivaled King of the Seas, Namor surfs into battle on a mighty wave with an army of fierce aquatic creatures in his wake. When ancient horns of war blare, devastation soon follows as deadly waters engulf the arena.

Teamup.name: DEEP WRATH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Whenever Hela participates in a KO, an Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position. While an Undead Monstro is present, casting Piercing Night will command the Monstro to spit a Nightsword Thorn at the nearest enemy.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Namor, each attack during Goddess of Death spawns an Undead Monstro at the point of impact.

Teamup.name: CHILLING CHARISMA
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to summon a Frost Tide forward. The wave damages, Pushes Back, and inflicts a Slow on all enemies hit. Additionally, Monstro Spawns are replaced by Frozen Spawns, which apply a Slow to enemies they hit.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the Frost Tide gains 1 charge and crashes down upon reaching its maximum range, dealing area damage and Slowing enemies caught near the endpoint.

Teamup.name: GAMMA MONSTRO
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Summon an extra Gamma Monstro that continuously damages the nearest enemy. Upon landing critical hits, the Gamma Monstro gains increased Attack Speed. Hitting an enemy with Wrath of the Seven Seas prompts it to fire a powerful beam.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, casting Blessing of the Deep creates a water barrier infused with Gamma energy. Standing inside accelerates the Gamma Monstro cooldown and grants it a Damage Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: TRIDENT OF NEPTUNE
ActiveAbilities.text: Throw the trident forward, reducing Aquatic Dominion's cooldown upon enemy impact. Critical hits cause Monstro Spawn to enter a berserk state, gaining increased Attack Speed.

ActiveAbilities.name: WRATH OF THE SEVEN SEAS
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch the trident forward to damage nearby enemies, then direct all Monstro Spawn to perform an enhanced attack on the nearest hit enemy. When the trident hits an enemy, Monstro Spawn to enter a berserk state, gaining increased Attack Speed.

ActiveAbilities.name: BLESSING OF THE DEEP
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon a protective barrier while flying upwards.

ActiveAbilities.name: AQUATIC DOMINION
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon a Monstro Spawn that can autonomously attack enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: HORN OF PROTEUS
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon Giganto to leap atop enemies within range, disabling their mobility abilities.

ActiveAbilities.name: TIDE FALL
ActiveAbilities.text: HOLD SPACE to fall slowly.

heroes.name: Adam Warlock
heroes.description: The genetically-engineered Adam Warlock wields powerful Quantum Magic, enabling him to connect and heal souls with a gentle touch. When the time comes for his allies to unite, Warlock stands as the unwavering epicenter of cosmic justice!

Teamup.name: VITALITY PACT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upon defeat, Mantis can freely move as a soul, healing nearby allies, and reforge her body at a chosen spot. After using Natural Anger, the effect of Nature's Favor is enhanced, increasing the amount of healing provided.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, her soul state can forge Soul Bond with nearby teammates, granting Healing Over Time and distributing damage taken across the bond.

Teamup.name: DUALITY DANCE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cast Soul Bond to tether all characters within range. Attacking tethered enemies or healing linked allies restores your Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, scoring critical hits with Light & Dark Ice reduces the cooldowns of Absolute Zero and Ice Arts.

Teamup.name: STAR-SOUL
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to place a Telekinetic Beacon. You can teleport back to the location where the beacon is deployed from anywhere on the map. Upon defeat, Star-Lord will cocoon and respawn at the Telekinetic Beacon's coordinates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, every time Star-Lord participates in a KO, Telekinetic Beaconcooldown is reduced.

Teamup.name: COSMIC CYCLONE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, linked teammates additionally gain a Damage Boost.

Teamup.name: FLAWLESS DESIGN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cosmic Cluster now provides healing to allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Ultron, Cosmic Cluster creates an explosion upon impact.

ActiveAbilities.name: QUANTUM MAGIC
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch quantum energy to deal damage. Critical hits reduce the cooldown of Avatar Life Stream.

ActiveAbilities.name: COSMIC CLUSTER
ActiveAbilities.text: Gather quantum energy into a cluster and then swiftly launch it at the enemy. Each hit reduces Avatar Life Stream charge time.

ActiveAbilities.name: AVATAR LIFE STREAM
ActiveAbilities.text: Target an ally for a bouncing stream of healing energy, which also heals himself upon casting; self-targets if no ally is selected.

ActiveAbilities.name: SOUL BOND
ActiveAbilities.text: Forge a soul bond with allies, granting Healing Over Time and distributing damage taken across the bond. While the bond persists, Adam can fly freely.

ActiveAbilities.name: KARMIC REVIVAL
ActiveAbilities.text: Awaken the karma of allies to revive them. Allies revived have lower health but gain some Bonus Health and enjoy a brief period of invincibility.

ActiveAbilities.name: SOARING SURGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Take to the skies, entering a flying state and swiftly surge forward.

heroes.name: Jeff The Land Shark
heroes.description: Most land sharks are vicious creatures of the deep... but not Jeff! This adorable and mischievous little guy brings joy and healing to every battle. But if the tide turns, Jeff can morph into a voracious beast, capable of swallowing an army of foes in a single gulp!

Teamup.name: JAWS OF FATE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a torrential downpour that continuously heals both herself and her teammates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, casting Omega Hurricane allows Jeff to swim inside the cyclone, generating a localized Jeff-nado.

Teamup.name: BUBBLE BUDDIES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Retreat inside a Bubble Shield to enter an Invincible state, granting self-targeted Continuous Healing.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, the healing effect inside the bubble is enhanced, and any excess healing converts into Bonus Health.

Teamup.name: GUARDIAN OF THE DEEP
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Shoot out healing tendrils; linked allies receive Continuous Healing, and excess healing is converted into Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, symbiote tendrils can also lash out at nearby enemies within range, inflicting continuous damage.

Teamup.name: MR. POOL'S INTERDIMENSIONAL TOY BOX
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to spit out a Deadpool Plushie. The plushie continuously Taunts nearby enemies while spraying a healing mist onto surrounding allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, the Deadpool Plushie asserts a much stronger Taunt while concurrently damaging enemies caught in its radius.

Teamup.name: SURF & TURF
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Impact Beam is replaced by a frontal water spray. This stream damages enemies while providing healing to teammates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, Jeff can ride atop Devil Dinosaur's head. While riding, both gain some Damage Reduction and are swirled in therapeutic waters, receiving Continuous Healing.

ActiveAbilities.name: JOYFUL SPLASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash a splash that damages enemies and heals allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: AQUA BURST
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a high-speed water sphere that bursts upon impact, dealing damage to enemies within range. Direct hits Launch Up enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: HEALING BUBBLE
ActiveAbilities.text: Spit a bubble that heals the ally who collects it, granting them Healing and Movement Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: HIDE AND SEEK
ActiveAbilities.text: Dive into the scene with only his dorsal fin exposed, granting himself a Movement Boost. Jeff can heal while submerged and gains the wall-crawl ability.

ActiveAbilities.name: IT'S JEFF!
ActiveAbilities.text: Deep dive into the scene and leave behind a healing water zone for allies. Upon resurfacing, swallow both enemies and allies within range, activating Hide and Seek for a brief duration before ejecting the swallowed heroes forward. Excess healing converts to Bonus Health.

Passives.name: OBLIVIOUS CUTENESS
Passives.text: Reduce damage taken from critical hits.

heroes.name: Psylocke
heroes.description: The psychic warrior known as Sai has the Mutant ability to conjure a variety of weapons with the power of her mind. Gracefully gliding across the battlefield, this trained ninja can shatter the enemy's defenses with a single thought.

Teamup.name: SENBONZAKURA STRIKE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Blast Arrow to Psionic Arrow. While drawn, Hawkeye can continuously bank extra Psionic Arrows. Releasing the bowstring fires all accumulated arrows forward simultaneously.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the nocking speed for each Psionic Arrow is significantly quickened, and they explode upon hitting enemies or the environment.

Teamup.name: LIGHT & DARK DARTS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a ring of Light Darts in all directions that damage enemies and restore Psylocke's Health upon impact, leaving behind a Shadow Domain. Staying inside the domain for a short time will re-enter Stealth.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, the radius of the Shadow Domain expands, and each time re-entering Stealth, the Light Darts are fired in all directions again.

Teamup.name: MENTAL PROJECTION
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Create an illusory projection that automatically dashes forward to use Psi-Blade Dash, while Psylocke enters Stealth. If Psylocke attacks, the illusion mimics her strikes.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, Psylocke's mental powers are elevated, allowing her to reactivate the ability to instantly swap places with her illusion.

Teamup.name: PSIONIC FOX
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activating Fox Form Awakening no longer consumes Spirit Tail energy, and grants the maximum possible duration immediately upon use.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the cooldown for Fox Form Awakening is drastically reduced.

ActiveAbilities.name: PSIONIC CROSSBOW
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash bolts with psionic crossbows to damage enemies and reduce the cooldowns of all her abilities.

ActiveAbilities.name: WING SHURIKENS
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a volley of psionic shurikens that stick to enemies, dealing damage and granting herself Bonus Health. Press again to recall the shurikens.

ActiveAbilities.name: PSI-BLADE DASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward and slice through enemies along the path with psionic blades.

ActiveAbilities.name: PSYCHIC STEALTH
ActiveAbilities.text: Enter stealth and gain a Movement Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: DANCE OF THE BUTTERFLY
ActiveAbilities.text: Slash nearby enemies with a psionic katana, dealing massive damage.

heroes.name: Wolverine
heroes.description: Thanks to his regenerative healing factor and berserker rage, the centuries-old Logan can fight through the worst pain to go claw-to-claw with any foe. The Wolverine stands ready to shred through all obstacles in his way with his Adamantium claws.

Teamup.name: GAMMA FASTBALL
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Enter a Furious state upon activation, gaining Speed Boost and Attack Speed for a duration. Also unlocks the Scars of Rage ability, granting Unstoppable for a period when Health drops to a certain threshold.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Wolverine, unlocks the Fastball Special. Upon mutual confirmation, Hulk hurls Wolverine forward and enters Furious state.

Teamup.name: PAIR OF THREES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upon activation, Wolverine receives Kinetic Enhancement, gaining increased Movement Speed and a Jump Boost. Attacking enemies applies Kinetic Particles that detonate after a short delay for bonus damage. The effect lasts for duration.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Wolverine receives Continuous Healing for the entire duration of the ability.

Teamup.name: BLAST SLASH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activation extends the attack range of Savage Claw and Berserk Claw Strike. Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cyclops, Blast Slash is permanently active.

ActiveAbilities.name: SAVAGE CLAW
ActiveAbilities.text: Slash with Adamantium claws for a Claw Strike. Unleashing Feral Leap will enhance it to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period.

ActiveAbilities.name: VICIOUS RAMPAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward and unleash a Claw Strike.

ActiveAbilities.name: UNDYING ANIMAL
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash a fierce howl to briefly reduce incoming damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: FERAL LEAP
ActiveAbilities.text: Leap like an animal to snatch the first enemy upon impact and Smash them to the ground. Unleashing this ability will enhance his normal attack to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period.

ActiveAbilities.name: LAST STAND
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch Up enemies ahead and spiral through the air, sweeping up enemies along the path and delivering a devastating impact at the landing point. Impact deals extra damage based on Rage accumulated.

Passives.name: REGENERATIVE HEALING FACTOR
Passives.text: Begin to heal and rise with a hefty Bonus Health, shaking off all debuffs. After a brief moment, any remaining Bonus Health morphs into a one-off heal, zeroing out his Rage. Assists in KOs reduce this cooldown.

Passives.name: BERSERKER RAGE
Passives.text: Rage builds when Wolverine attacks or takes hits, boosting the damage of his Claw Strikes and the Bonus Health from his regenerative healing factor.

heroes.name: Invisible Woman
heroes.description: The Invisible Woman is able to slip in and out of sight without a trace. No matter how intense the battle may be, Susan Storm always keeps her cool, conjuring up impenetrable force fields to protect herself and her team.

Teamup.name: PSIONIC VORTEX
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Maelstrom of Madness to Psionic Vortex. Enemies caught in are Launched toward you. Shield of the Seraphim also gains increased shield value.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Invisible Woman, any damage dealt by Psionic Vortex provides proportional Bonus Health for Doctor Strange.

Teamup.name: UNITED SIBLINGS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Generate a Flame Shield for a targeted ally that blocks incoming damage while providing a Continuous Healing aura to everyone nearby. Projectiles from teammates shot through the Flame Shield receive a Damage Boost. Enemies that pass though the shield are Slowed
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, the Flame Shield boasts a larger radius and heavily increased shield value.

Teamup.name: FIRST FAMILY
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Invisible Woman and surrounding allies enter Invisible state, gaining healing and a Speed Boost. The effect ends if they take damage or the duration expires. Disengaging from combat for a duration will reenter the Invisible state.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mister Fantastic, the healing and Speed Boost effects are enhanced, and the Invisible state duration is increased.

Teamup.name: UNBREAKABLE FORCES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Generate a layer of Psionic Armor upon activation, granting Bonus Health scaling off currently missing Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up Invisible Woman, the Psionic Armor is fortified. While active, every time The Thing takes a set amount of damage, the armor pulses out a wave of area healing for allies. Furthermore, the conversion ratio for missing Health into Bonus Health is increased.

ActiveAbilities.name: AGILE STRIKE
ActiveAbilities.text: Release a three-hit combo, the third attack will launch up enemies in front.

ActiveAbilities.name: VEILED STEP
ActiveAbilities.text: Generate a force field at your feet; stepping on it propels you into Invisible state. For a short period after becoming Invisible, taking damage will not break the state.

ActiveAbilities.name: GUARDIAN SHIELD
ActiveAbilities.text: Generate a force shield in front of a selected ally or press F to generate in front of you. The shield can block damage and provide Healing Over Time to nearby allies. Enemies that pass through the shield are slowed.

ActiveAbilities.name: PSIONIC VORTEX
ActiveAbilities.text: Gather psionic energy and then cast it. Upon impact or pressing the E key again, it erupts into a psionic vortex, continuously drawing in enemies and causing damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: FORCE PHYSICS
ActiveAbilities.text: Manipulate psionic energy to push or pull enemies in front of you.

ActiveAbilities.name: INVISIBLE BOUNDARY
ActiveAbilities.text: Manifest an unseen force field within a chosen area, rendering allies inside undetectable by enemies and providing Healing Over Time. Enemies that pass through the field are Slowed.

ActiveAbilities.name: ORB PROJECTION
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a force field that can pierce heroes, flying to maximum distance before returning to Invisible Woman; damaging enemies and healing teammates.

Passives.name: COVERT ADVANCE
Passives.text: Enter Invisible state some time after disengaging from combat and grant yourself Healing Over Time.

heroes.name: The Thing
heroes.description: Benjamin J. Grimm is unquestionably the rock star of any team he's on. Always at the forefront of the fight, the Thing shields his allies with his unbreakable form, selflessly fending off any harm that comes their way.

Teamup.name: CLOBBERIN' RESEARCH DEPT.
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Toggle Ability. In brawler stance, Stretch Punch becomes a charged ability, firing a forward Brawling Punch. Hitting an enemy grants Bonus Health scaling with damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Thing, while in the brawling stance, Distended Grip also becomes a charged ability, slamming down a Distended Hammer. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health based on damage, and a full charge Launches hit enemies.

Teamup.name: TWO-IN-ONE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Enter an enhanced state upon activation. For the duration, The Thing's fists are violently engulfed in flames. Every Rocky Jab deals splash damage, and every Stone Haymaker creates an explosion, dealing damage in a frontal cone.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage and Stun to enemies. The Thing then automatically enters his flaming enhanced state upon landing.

Teamup.name: UNBREAKABLE FORCES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Generate a layer of Psionic Armor upon activation, granting Bonus Health scaling off currently missing Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up Invisible Woman, the Psionic Armor is fortified. While active, every time The Thing takes a set amount of damage, the armor pulses out a wave of area healing for allies. Furthermore, the conversion ratio for missing Health into Bonus Health is increased.

Teamup.name: IRON & STONE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a powerful uppercut to Launch Up enemies; can be followed up with a sweeping kick after release.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up The Thing, the uppercut can still be chained directly into a sweeping leg kick, and the damage dealt is increased.

ActiveAbilities.name: ROCKY JAB
ActiveAbilities.text: Rapidly punch forward.

ActiveAbilities.name: STONE HAYMAKER
ActiveAbilities.text: Deliver a devastating Heavy Blow that inflicts additional damage with each strike! Upon hit, gain Bonus Health. Can Knock Down flying enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: YANCY STREET CHARGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Continuously charge forward, launching up enemies and leaving behind a zone at the final position that prevents the use of mobility abilities.

ActiveAbilities.name: EMBATTLED LEAP
ActiveAbilities.text: Jump toward an ally and apply damage reduction to yourself and allies within the landing area.

ActiveAbilities.name: CLOBBERIN' TIME
ActiveAbilities.text: Use immense power to launch all enemies in front of you into the air.

ActiveAbilities.name: BATTLE BLITZ
ActiveAbilities.text: Jump toward an enemy and apply Vulnerability to enemies within the landing area.

Passives.name: UNYIELDING WILL
Passives.text: Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects.

heroes.name: Iron Fist
heroes.description: Lin Lie is a master of Chinese martial arts who once wielded the shattered Sword of Fu Xi. After fusing its pieces with the mighty Chi of Shou-Lao, he is poised to strike his foes with the grace and force of a soaring dragon as the latest immortal Iron Fist.

Teamup.name: KUMIHO PALM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Hitting an enemy with Yat Jee Chung Kuen provides a burst of healing to nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up White Fox, the lock-on distance for Yat Jee Chung Kuen is significantly increased.

Teamup.name: IRON & STONE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a powerful uppercut to Launch Up enemies; can be followed up with a sweeping kick after release.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up The Thing, the uppercut can still be chained directly into a sweeping leg kick, and the damage dealt is increased.

Teamup.name: COMPREHENSIVE DEFENSE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Objection! is enhanced. Whirling billy clubs now damage all enemies in range while deflecting Projectiles from all directions. Successfully deflecting attacks recovers Fury.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Fist, Daredevil passively recovers Health for the entire duration of the ability.

ActiveAbilities.name: CRANE LEAP
ActiveAbilities.text: Perform up to three consecutive jumps while airborne.

ActiveAbilities.name: JEET KUNE DO
ActiveAbilities.text: Strike the targeted enemy with Jeet Kune Do, and the last strike will Launch Up enemies, reducing the cooldown of Dragon's Defense with every hit.

ActiveAbilities.name: DRAGON'S DEFENSE
ActiveAbilities.text: Assume a defensive stance with a boost of Chi to block incoming attacks and gain Damage Reduction. Once he exits the defensive stance, he gains Bonus Health and can strike back with Yat Jee Chung Kuen.

ActiveAbilities.name: YAT JEE CHUNG KUEN
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward to pursue the targeted enemy and unleash a flurry of attacks.

ActiveAbilities.name: HARMONY RECOVERY
ActiveAbilities.text: Cross legs and channel Chi, recovering health. Excess healing converts to Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: K'UN-LUN KICK
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward, delivering a flying kick when hitting an enemy or reaching full range, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Damage increases with lower enemy health.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIVING CHI
ActiveAbilities.text: Become living Chi to boost his speed, damage, and attack range, delivering stronger punches while reducing the cooldown of Dragon's Defense.

Passives.name: WALL RUNNER
Passives.text: Run horizontally along the walls.

Passives.name: CHI ABSORPTION
Passives.text: Assists in taking down enemies allow him to absorb their Chi and gain Bonus Health.

heroes.name: Emma Frost
heroes.description: For Emma Frost, war is the purest form of art. With her formidable telepathic abilities, she intricately weaves a deadly mental web that ensnares her foes, while her indestructible diamond form lets her lead her teammates fearlessly into the fray. Forever elegant and composed, Emma reigns as the one true queen of the battlefield!

Teamup.name: MAGNETIC RESONANCE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Cast a magnetic projection that mimics Magneto's movement and ability casts perfectly from the enemy's perspective.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, the magnetic projection receives a massive Health bump and will persist indefinitely unless destroyed or manually recalled.

Teamup.name: MENTAL PROJECTION
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Create an illusory projection that automatically dashes forward to use Psi-Blade Dash, while Psylocke enters Stealth. If Psylocke attacks, the illusion mimics her strikes.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, Psylocke's mental powers are elevated, allowing her to reactivate the ability to instantly swap places with her illusion.

Teamup.name: ICED OUT DIAMOND
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. In diamond form, condense frost into an Absolute Zero Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, entering Diamond Form imbues all damaging abilities with a Slow effect. Telepathic Pulse will also inflict a Slow effect.

Teamup.name: SPIRIT BREAKER
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Damaging an enemy's sentience directly converts that damage into Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, shattering a sentience grants one-time Bonus Health while simultaneously reducing the cooldown of Psychic Spear.

ActiveAbilities.name: TELEPATHIC PULSE
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a psionic beam to deal damage; the longer the beam hits, the higher the damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: MIND'S AEGIS
ActiveAbilities.text: Create a levitating barrier at the designated location.

ActiveAbilities.name: DIAMOND FORM
ActiveAbilities.text: Activate Diamond Form to transform your attack style while gaining Damage Reduction and becoming Unstoppable.

ActiveAbilities.name: PSYCHIC SPEAR
ActiveAbilities.text: Seize control of an enemy's sentience—damage dealt to the sentience cascades to the physical form and can be pierced by Telepathic Pulse. When the sentience shatters, it unleashes extra damage on its owner.

ActiveAbilities.name: PSIONIC SEDUCTION
ActiveAbilities.text: Project a forward psychic assault that stuns foes and prevents them from unleashing their Ultimate Abilities; if the effect lingers, it gradually commandeers their mind, forcing them to move toward Emma Frost.

ActiveAbilities.name: FACETED FURY
ActiveAbilities.text: In Diamond Form, deliver a crushing double-fisted strike to enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: CRYSTAL KICK
ActiveAbilities.text: In Diamond Form, unleash a flying kick forward and knock back enemies; extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall.

ActiveAbilities.name: CARBON CRUSH
ActiveAbilities.text: In Diamond Form, lunge forward to grab an enemy, then execute a back slam to inflict damage.

heroes.name: Phoenix
heroes.description: Original X-Man Jean Grey boasted immense psychic power even before becoming host to the unbridled Phoenix Force, embodiment of life and psionic energy across the universe. Now aligned with this ancient cosmic power, Jean and the Phoenix traverse space together, burning bright as both a spark of creation and inferno of destruction!

Teamup.name: BURNING BULLETS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activation grants the Red Room Rifle a Fire Rate Boost. Additionally, the Plasma Cannon projectile becomes a hitscan laser that no longer requires charging.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, her Plasma Cannon gains a second ability charge.

Teamup.name: ABYSSAL FLAMES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Ignite the symbiote with Phoenix Flames for a duration, replacing Dark Predation with a sweeping Avian Claw frontal slash.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Venom's Phoenix Force is enhanced: every Avian Claw applies a Spark. Upon reaching three stacks, the Sparks detonate.

Teamup.name: CIRCLE OF LIFE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Psionic Detonation is replaced by Phoenix Netherfire, applying a Telekinetic Mark to the targeted location. Upon hitting, it triggers an initial small explosion that briefly Stuns enemies, followed by two larger explosions that apply a Healing Reduction effect. Every single blast inflicts Sparks onto the enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, every blast in the sequence applies multiple stacks of Sparks to enemies caught within.

Teamup.name: TELEKINETIC BEATDOWN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Fire a telekinetic shockwave forward. If it lands, the Phoenix Force rushes the enemy and delivers a powerful punch. If there are other targets nearby, the Phoenix Force rapidly blinks between them to strike them as well, inflicting a Spark on each victim while healing Phoenix.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rogue, add an additional Spark stack, gain more healing, and increase the maximum number of strikes.

Teamup.name: SLIM AND RED
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Hitting an enemy with Ricochet Force summons the Phoenix Force to ignite them, causing continuous burn damage over a set duration. Hitting an ignited target with Optic Blast or Concussive Beam instantly triggers a percentage of the remaining burn damage as a single burst.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Spark detonations reduce the cooldown of Ricochet Force.

ActiveAbilities.name: COSMIC FLAMES
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a fiery projectile forward, applying 1 Spark to enemies hit. Critical hits apply 2 Sparks. At 3 Sparks Phoenix triggers a fiery explosion that applies 1 Spark to enemies around and Healing Over Time to self. Sparks from explosions will not stack within a brief period.

ActiveAbilities.name: PSIONIC DETONATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Mark a targeted area with psionic energy, followed by a series of fiery explosions. The first blast Stuns enemies, while the subsequent two explosions inflict Slow. Applies 1 Spark to enemies hit.

ActiveAbilities.name: DARK ASCENT
ActiveAbilities.text: Merge with the Phoenix, entering a state of free flight. Gain a Movement Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: TELEPATHIC ILLUSION
ActiveAbilities.text: Leave behind an illusion and instantly teleport in the desired direction, followed by detonating the illusion. Enemies hit are applied with 1 Spark.

ActiveAbilities.name: ENDSONG INFERNO
ActiveAbilities.text: Soar into the sky with the Phoenix and crash down onto a selected area, dealing devastating damage to enemies while creating a shockwave that destroys enemy Summons, Shields, and any Bonus Health. Enemies hit are applied with 1 Spark.

heroes.name: Daredevil
heroes.description: A tragic accident transformed Matt Murdock, blinding him, but awakening his incredible Radar Sense. When darkness falls, Daredevil wields his billy clubs in place of a gavel, doling out justice and purging the world of evil!

Teamup.name: BESTIAL HUNT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Shoot piercing bullets that carry a Damage Boost effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Daredevil, the bullets break enemy summoned walls and shields more quickly.

Teamup.name: COMPREHENSIVE DEFENSE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Objection! is enhanced. Whirling billy clubs now damage all enemies in range while deflecting Projectiles from all directions. Successfully deflecting attacks recovers Fury.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Fist, Daredevil passively recovers Health for the entire duration of the ability.

Teamup.name: DEVILISH AFFAIR
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Swings Devil's Chain in a criss-cross pattern, dealing damage to enemies in front and inflicting a Slow. 
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Widow, the damage radius is expanded, and landing hits recovers Fury.

ActiveAbilities.name: SONIC PURSUIT
ActiveAbilities.text: Locks onto a target, gaining increased Speed; and Damage Reduction when attacked. While in range, dash to the target, Blinding them and restore Fury.

ActiveAbilities.name: BLIND ASCENT
ActiveAbilities.text: Cling to walls and spring off them to reposition.

ActiveAbilities.name: JUSTICE JAB
ActiveAbilities.text: Swing Billy Clubs forward. Gain Fury on hit.

ActiveAbilities.name: OBJECTION!
ActiveAbilities.text: Whirl billy clubs in a tight guard to block frontal damage and reflect projectiles, becoming immune to all incoming harm during this stance and gain Fury.

ActiveAbilities.name: DEVIL'S LATCH
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a grappling line that reels Daredevil and his target toward each other. On completion, gain Fury and temporarily enables Righteous Cross.

ActiveAbilities.name: LET THE DEVIL OUT
ActiveAbilities.text: Embrace the Beast within. Enemies with Daredevil in their line of sight take damage and suffer a ramping Blind effect. Continually gain Fury while active.

ActiveAbilities.name: RIGHTEOUS CROSS
ActiveAbilities.text: Cross Billy Clubs and surge forward. Gain Fury on hit.

ActiveAbilities.name: INFERNAL FURY
ActiveAbilities.text: Consume Fury to unleash either Devil's Chain or Devil's Throw. Devil's Chain converts damage dealt into Bonus Health; Devil's Throw Slows hit targets. Both temporarily enable Righteous Cross.

Passives.name: RADAR SENSE
Passives.text: Detect enemy movements within a set radius.

heroes.name: Angela
heroes.description: As the Hand of Heven, the warrior called Angela embodies unwavering courage and determination. Able to manipulate Ichors into various weapons and unfurl her wings to soar across the battlefield, she is ready to deliver divine judgment upon her foes!

Teamup.name: DIVINE ARMORY
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Angela, leaping to the Thunder Spear grants Bonus Health.

Teamup.name: ODIN'S UNACKNOWLEDGED
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Project an Illusion forward. The illusion utilizes Assassin's Charge to thrust at enemies. Enemies struck head-on will be carried through the air for a short while.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Loki, the ability gains two charges.

Teamup.name: ASGARDIANS OF THE GALAXY
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activation grants Reveal within a targeted area. Activating the ability again performs a slam attack; enemies hit by the slam are Grounded.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, Angela gains Bonus Health scaling with the number of enemies struck by the slam.

ActiveAbilities.name: HEVEN'S RETRIBUTION
ActiveAbilities.text: Wrap your spear in ribbons and hurl it with force. Upon impact, the ribbons bind nearby enemies. Angela can leap to the spear's location, damaging surrounding enemies and creating a Divine Judgement Zone.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPEAR OF ICHORS
ActiveAbilities.text: Lunge forward with your spear, dealing damage that increases with Attack Charge. At full charge, Spear of Ichor can deal more damage and launch up enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: AXES OF ICHORS
ActiveAbilities.text: Alternate powerful strikes forward with twin axes, dealing increased damage as Attack Charge grows. The fourth strike propels you forward in a swift dash.

ActiveAbilities.name: SHIELDED STANCE
ActiveAbilities.text: Transform Ichors into a shield, gaining Attack Charge when absorbing damage. Releasing the shield increases its recovery rate.

ActiveAbilities.name: ASSASSIN'S CHARGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Enter an accelerated dash state. Enemies struck head-on are carried through the air for a short distance.

ActiveAbilities.name: DIVINE JUDGEMENT
ActiveAbilities.text: Dive downward, switch to twin axes and infuse the ground with Ichors to create a Divine Judgement Zone upon impact. Within the zone, gain enhanced Speed and attacks grant Bonus Health to self and nearby allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: WINGBLADE ASCENT
ActiveAbilities.text: Take to the skies, switching back to Spear of Ichors.

Passives.name: SERAPHIC SOAR
Passives.text: Glide freely through the air. Continuous flight builds Attack Charge.

heroes.name: Gambit
heroes.description: Charming and free-spirited, Remy LeBeau manipulates kinetic energy with unmatched skill. With a flick of his wrist, his charged playing cards become explosive projectiles for foes or heal his allies through kinetic shifting. When the charismatic Gambit lights up the battlefield, he always plays to win!

Teamup.name: PAIR OF THREES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Upon activation, Wolverine receives Kinetic Enhancement, gaining increased Movement Speed and a Jump Boost. Attacking enemies applies Kinetic Particles that detonate after a short delay for bonus damage. The effect lasts for duration.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Wolverine receives Continuous Healing for the entire duration of the ability.

Teamup.name: GUMBO CHIMICHANGAS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, Duelist/Vanguard Deadpool scatters a ring of kinetically charged Chimichangas that deal damage to enemies. Strategist Deadpool's Chimichangas additionally heal allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

Teamup.name: FAVORABLE ODDS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Throw two magnetic playing cards forward. Upon hitting the environment or a character, the cards magnetically repel and unfurl, spinning in place for a duration. They heal allies they hit, while damaging and Launching enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, after the duration ends, the magnetic poles of the cards reverse. They violently slam back together and explode, providing an extra burst of healing to allies and damage to enemies.

Teamup.name: SPARKLING STAFF
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Twirl your firework-energy enhanced bo staff. The radiating firework sparks provide healing to nearby allies. Concurrently, the staff deals damage to close-range enemies, and the rapid spinning blocks incoming damage from most projectiles.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, both Bayou Bash and Big Easy Impact gain an additional Continuous Healing aura.

Teamup.name: KINETIC KIN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Release stored kinetic energy to enter an enhanced state for a duration. While active, Cyclops gains significantly increased movement speed and jump height.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, during the enhanced state, the attack speeds for both Optic Blast and Concussive Beam are increased.

Teamup.name: MR. & MRS. X
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: After activation, every attack triggers a kinetic explosion, dealing area damage to surrounding enemies while simultaneously healing nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Rogue remains permanently locked in the "Hearts as One" state.

ActiveAbilities.name: KINETIC CARDS
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch three kinetic-charged cards in an arc ahead. Each card detonates on impact, creating a single-target explosion that damages enemies and heals allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: BAYOU BASH
ActiveAbilities.text: Channel kinetic energy into the bo staff, then slam it into the ground after a sweeping strike, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and heals allies. Follow up Cajun Charge with Big Easy Impact to sprint forward while striking with the bo staff, triggering three kinetic explosions along the path.

ActiveAbilities.name: CAJUN CHARGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Side-step forward with bo staff in hand, dashing a short distance.

ActiveAbilities.name: HEALING HEARTS
ActiveAbilities.text: Conjure a Heart card by consuming one stack of Sleight of Hand to Heal and switch to the Healing Hearts deck.

ActiveAbilities.name: BREAKING SPADES
ActiveAbilities.text: Conjure a Spade card by consuming one stack of Sleight of Hand to gain a Damage Boost and switch to the Breaking Spades deck.

ActiveAbilities.name: RAGIN' ROYAL FLUSH
ActiveAbilities.text: Lock onto an ally within sight and unleash multiple Aces that heal and Purify. Both enter the Kinetic Transfer state, granting increased Movement Speed and Jump Boost, while enhancing attacks with additional single-target explosive damage and providing the ally with Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration.

heroes.name: Elsa Bloodstone
heroes.description: Born into a line of legendary monster hunters, Elsa Bloodstone boasts incredible physical prowess and an innate talent for subduing the creepiest of creatures. The instinct to hunt is in her blood, and every foe she faces inevitably becomes prey ensnared in her traps!

Teamup.name: BLOOD MOON
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Deploy an Ankh Trap. Upon triggering, an Ankh materializes at the location, while summoning a single Talon of Khonshu to Launch enemies toward the trap's center.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, triggering the trap summons multiple Talons of Khonshu to bombard the area.

Teamup.name: EXPERT INSTINCT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Securing or participating in a KO grants a stack of Culling Instinct. Each stack reduces the cooldowns of Winter Soldier's other abilities. Stacks are lost upon defeat.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, the Bonus Health generated by Ceaseless Charge is increased.

Teamup.name: PREHISTORIC TRAP
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: After deploying the Smoky Snare trap, Diablo will monitor the area. If enemies approach, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. He also releases a lethal gas, causing continuous area damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Devil Dinosaur, Elsa can store and deploy two Smoky Snares.

Teamup.name: LOUDMOUTH MERCS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. After a timer, the bullet auto-recalls, healing Elsa based on the damage dealt while adding one extra gauge block to her Inherited Instinct passive cap.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, Deadpool breaks the fourth wall, significantly boosting Instinct acquisition rate.

ActiveAbilities.name: DOUBLE-BARREL BLASTER
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire your shotgun forward.

ActiveAbilities.name: MONSTER-PIERCER
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash your elephant gun forward. Bullets pierce enemies and deal high damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: RUTHLESS PURSUIT
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward, gaining Bonus Health and launching enemies hit. Follow up with a Double-Barrel Blaster shot that propels you backward and Slows enemies. Using either stage empowers your next Double-Barrel Blaster, transforming it into Monster-Piercer.

ActiveAbilities.name: HELIX ADVANCE
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash in your movement direction. Your next Double-Barrel Blaster becomes Monster-Piercer.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIVING BULLET
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a Living Bullet round that splits upon impact, seeking nearby enemies and marking each with a Spectral Sigil. Hitting marked targets with Double-Barrel Blaster or Monster-Piercer grants Elsa a brief Speed boost. Living Bullets deal extra damage to shields and enemies with Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: SMOKY SNARE
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a trap containing the monster Diablo. Once deployed, it becomes Invisible and Invulnerable. When an enemy triggers it, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. Use F to dash to the trapped enemy. Enemies can destroy Diablo to break free.

ActiveAbilities.name: APEX PREDATOR
ActiveAbilities.text: Summon the Glartrox to charge forward. The Glartrox can be recalled to charge back toward Elsa. When colliding with terrain or upon return, it bites fiercely, dealing heavy damage.

Passives.name: INHERITED INSTINCT
Passives.text: Dealing damage increases hunting Instinct. Defeating enemies caught by Smoky Snare grants additional Instinct. Higher Instinct reduces the cooldown of Helix Advance.

heroes.name: White Fox
heroes.description: Ami Han, the last of the legendary Kumiho, can summon her ancestral Nine-Tailed Power to fortify herself and heal her allies on the battlefield. As the calm and capable Director of Tiger Division, she is any team's unwavering backbone, no matter the foe.

Teamup.name: ATLAS BOND
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a spirit fox forward that Charmsenemies while healing any allies in its path.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with White Fox, the spirit fox automatically returns after reaching its maximum distance.

Teamup.name: KUMIHO PALM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Hitting an enemy with Yat Jee Chung Kuen provides a burst of healing to nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up White Fox, the lock-on distance for Yat Jee Chung Kuen is significantly increased.

Teamup.name: LUCKY LOAN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: White Fox receives an Orb of Life from Black Cat. Upon use, it recovers Spirit Tail Energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Aura that shoots out in all directions. This automatically tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting Speed and Healing to allies while damaging and Slowing enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Cat, using the Orb triggers a state where Spirit Tail Energy is no longer consumed for a duration, allowing free use of Spectral Surge and Fox Form Awakening.

Teamup.name: PSIONIC FOX
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activating Fox Form Awakening no longer consumes Spirit Tail energy, and grants the maximum possible duration immediately upon use.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the cooldown for Fox Form Awakening is drastically reduced.

ActiveAbilities.name: YEOWOO GUSEUL
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a Fox Marble forward that bounces off terrain or heroes, then homes in on nearby heroes. It damages enemies, heals allies, and restores Spirit Tail energy.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPECTRAL SURGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Consume one Spirit Tail to send a spectral fox forward and instantly restore Health. The fox heals and grants invulnerability to allies it passes through, while damaging and Charming enemies, luring them toward White Fox.

ActiveAbilities.name: FOX FORM AWAKENING
ActiveAbilities.text: Enter Awakened state, transforming Spirit Tails into physical tails. While active, continuously drain Spirit Tail energy and heal nearby allies. Striking enemies provides additional area healing.

ActiveAbilities.name: CLAW STRIKE
ActiveAbilities.text: While Awakened, slash forward with a flurry of attacks.

ActiveAbilities.name: TAIL SWEEP
ActiveAbilities.text: While Awakened, sweep forward tails to launch up hit enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: PREDATORY POUNCE
ActiveAbilities.text: While Awakened, dash forward. Hit an enemy to Slow and flip over them, enabling a second dash that knocks back enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPIRIT SANCTUARY
ActiveAbilities.text: Teleport to a chosen ally, instantly healing White Fox and allies in the area while generating a shield. While the shield is active, White Fox and allies within gain Healing Over Time.

ActiveAbilities.name: KUMIHO UNLEASHED
ActiveAbilities.text: Manifest the full Nine-Tailed Fox form, applying Blessed by the Nine to surrounding allies. While active, continuously heal nearby allies. Cannot receive healing effects from others while in this form.

ActiveAbilities.name: NINEFOLD SLAM
ActiveAbilities.text: In Kumiho Form, slam the ground, causing an explosive shockwave. Hitting enemies or summons grants One-Time Healing to self and nearby allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: BLESSED BY THE NINE
ActiveAbilities.text: In Kumiho Form, select an ally to grant Continuous Healing, Unstoppable, and Lifesteal for a short time.

heroes.name: Black Cat
heroes.description: One of the world's premier thieves, Felicia Hardy glides across the battlefield with swift precision and a dancer's grace, ever ready to purloin an opponent's fortune. Those who meet the Black Cat's gaze should beware, as her omens never miss their mark!

Teamup.name: LUCKY LOAN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: White Fox receives an Orb of Life from Black Cat. Upon use, it recovers Spirit Tail Energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Aura that shoots out in all directions. This automatically tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting Speed and Healing to allies while damaging and Slowing enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Cat, using the Orb triggers a state where Spirit Tail Energy is no longer consumed for a duration, allowing free use of Spectral Surge and Fox Form Awakening.

Teamup.name: FELINE ALLIANCE
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Taking damage accumulates Vibranium Energy. Upon reaching a specific threshold, Black Cat can unleash a violent explosion, damaging and Knocking back surrounding enemies while gaining a brief Speed Boost and Bonus Health. For every enemy hit, gain 50 Fortune, up to a max of 100.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, this explosion is no longer restricted by the Vibranium Energy threshold and can be triggered at any time.

Teamup.name: BINDING TIES
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Turn of Fortune is replaced by Spider-Web Grapple, which has 2 charges. Landing the grapple on an enemy steals Fortune and applies a Spider-Tracer. If Black Cat hits an enemy carrying a Spider-Tracer with any other ability, she triggers the mark to deal bonus damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, using Spider-Web Grapple to hit an enemy already marked with a Spider-Tracer temporarily Immobilizes them in place.

ActiveAbilities.name: STEALTHY CATWALK
ActiveAbilities.text: Hold SPACE to crawl up vertical surfaces.

ActiveAbilities.name: THIEVING GRACE
ActiveAbilities.text: Perform a double jump.

ActiveAbilities.name: FELINE FURY
ActiveAbilities.text: Swipe forward with razor-sharp claws.

ActiveAbilities.name: FORTUNE'S FAVOR
ActiveAbilities.text: Spend Fortune to unleash either Claw Whip or Phantom Pursuit.

ActiveAbilities.name: CAT'S CRADLE
ActiveAbilities.text: Lunge forward with claws bared, slicing through any enemies caught in your path.

ActiveAbilities.name: CALLING CARD
ActiveAbilities.text: Issue a Calling Card to all enemies. Instantly dash to any enemy in sight and range, tearing into them with your claws to deal Damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: TURN OF FORTUNE
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a grappling hook forward that damages an enemy on impact and steals Fortune.

ActiveAbilities.name: CLAW WHIP
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire out tethered claws and whip them forward in a devastating arc, dealing damage to all enemies caught in range.

ActiveAbilities.name: PHANTOM PURSUIT
ActiveAbilities.text: Swiftly dash to an enemy, unleash a rapid flurry of claw attacks, and flash back to your starting position. Gain Damage Reduction during this move.

Passives.name: MALKIN MISFORTUNE
Passives.text: Apply Jinx to enemies on hit. Jinxed foes have a chance to lose their bonus damage when striking Black Cat with a Critical Hit.

heroes.name: Devil Dinosaur
heroes.description: Don't let his name scare you — Devil Dinosaur is actually a gentle giant. But with razor-sharp fangs, a mighty sweeping tail, a thunderous roar, and a force-field shield gifted by his human partner Moon Girl, it's no wonder why heroes and villains alike are intimidated by this prehistoric powerhouse!

Teamup.name: PREHISTORIC TRAP
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: After deploying the Smoky Snare trap, Diablo will monitor the area. If enemies approach, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. He also releases a lethal gas, causing continuous area damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Devil Dinosaur, Elsa can store and deploy two Smoky Snares.

Teamup.name: SURF & TURF
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Impact Beam is replaced by a frontal water spray. This stream damages enemies while providing healing to teammates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, Jeff can ride atop Devil Dinosaur's head. While riding, both gain some Damage Reduction and are swirled in therapeutic waters, receiving Continuous Healing.

Teamup.name: PRIMAL PUNISHMENT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Adds a new ability. Upon activation, Primal Bite is replaced. Devil Dinosaur gains 2 magnetic cannons that can be fired forward; the cannonballs detonate when hitting enemies or the environment, applying Bleed.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the duo can request an interaction. Once accepted, The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher.

ActiveAbilities.name: PREHISTORIC PLATING
ActiveAbilities.text: Take reduced damage from critical hits. Immune to launch-up, knock-back, and other displacement effects. Enemies and allies generate less Ultimate Ability Energy when damaging or healing him.

ActiveAbilities.name: APEX ADVANTAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Gain Bonus Health when you inflict Bleeding and deal damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: PRIMAL BITE
ActiveAbilities.text: Bite forward. Applies a Bleed that deals continuous Percentage Damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: FRENZIED FEAST
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash a flurry of continuous bites, converting the damage dealt into Bonus Health. Deals extra damage against Bleeding targets.

ActiveAbilities.name: SAVAGE PREDATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash and pounce on your prey with a vicious bite, applying a Bleed. If the target is already Bleeding, clamp down before hurling them away.

ActiveAbilities.name: BUDDY BARRIER
ActiveAbilities.text: Activate the heart-shaped generator to expand a spherical shield that blocks incoming damage. Enemies caught within are Slowed.

ActiveAbilities.name: IMPACT BEAM
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash a devastating beam of energy that inflicts a Bleed and Slow.

ActiveAbilities.name: DEVIL-BEAST RAMPAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Erupt in primal fury! Gain a massive Movement Speed Boost while unleashing earth-shattering stomps that Launch enemies and apply a Bleed. Thunderous roars also emit sonic waves that Slow enemies hit.

heroes.name: Cyclops
heroes.description: Scott Summers leads the X-Men as Cyclops. Through his specialized ruby quartz visor, he precisely controls the devastating force channeled through his eyes, neutralizing any threat on the battlefield. But when that visor comes off, all restraint disappears, erupting into an unstoppable torrent of concussive energy!

Teamup.name: BLAST SLASH
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activation extends the attack range of Savage Claw and Berserk Claw Strike. Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cyclops, Blast Slash is permanently active.

Teamup.name: SLIM AND RED
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Hitting an enemy with Ricochet Force summons the Phoenix Force to ignite them, causing continuous burn damage over a set duration. Hitting an ignited target with Optic Blast or Concussive Beam instantly triggers a percentage of the remaining burn damage as a single burst.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Spark detonations reduce the cooldown of Ricochet Force.

Teamup.name: KINETIC KIN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Release stored kinetic energy to enter an enhanced state for a duration. While active, Cyclops gains significantly increased movement speed and jump height.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, during the enhanced state, the attack speeds for both Optic Blast and Concussive Beam are increased.

ActiveAbilities.name: OPTIC BLAST
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a quick burst of kinetic force forward. Hitting enemies accelerates Ricochet Force charge rate.

ActiveAbilities.name: CONCUSSIVE BEAM
ActiveAbilities.text: Continuously fire a powerful beam that can refract between enemies and the environment. Hitting enemies accelerates Ricochet Force charge rate.

ActiveAbilities.name: PROPULSION BURST
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a propulsion beam to push yourself and the target backward, applying a Slow effect to the enemy.

ActiveAbilities.name: RICOCHET FORCE
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a beam that can diffract and track nearby enemies after hitting terrain. Upon use, Cyclops gains Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: RUBY RAGE
ActiveAbilities.text: Remove visor and fire a powerful sweeping beam forward, destroying all barriers in its path. The blast leaves behind volatile excess energy that erupts, dealing massive secondary explosive damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: OPTIC ASCENT
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire a propulsion beam directly downward to push yourself up and knock back hit enemies, applying a Slow effect to them.

Passives.name: KINETIC HOVER
Passives.text: Enter a slow-fall state while firing Concussive Beam mid-air.

heroes.name: Jubilee
heroes.description: Jubilation Lee has the Mutant ability to generate bursts of pyrotechnic plasma. She shapes radiant energy into vibrant projectiles that shimmer with brilliant, colorful light. Combined with her vampiric powers, every one of Jubilee's fireworks is an invigorating celebration on the battlefield!

Teamup.name: FIERY SPARKS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Passively detect enemies in the immediate vicinity and launch tracking Firework Sparks to chip away their health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, successfully landing a Firework Spark on an enemy grants Human Torch Bonus Health.

Teamup.name: HEX FIREWORKS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Infuse firework energy into the Dark Seal forcefield, turning it into a Plasmoid Seal, allowing for a secondary blast. After expanding the Plasmoid Seal, pressing the SHIFT key again while it persists will detonate the fireworks, dealing damage and inflicting Vulnerability.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, Scarlet Witch receives constant healing from the firework energy while using Mystic Projection.

Teamup.name: SPARKLING STAFF
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Twirl your firework-energy enhanced bo staff. The radiating firework sparks provide healing to nearby allies. Concurrently, the staff deals damage to close-range enemies, and the rapid spinning blocks incoming damage from most projectiles.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, both Bayou Bash and Big Easy Impact gain an additional Continuous Healing aura.

Teamup.name: HELLFIRE SPARKS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: When Attack Speed is enhanced, Energy Plasmoids transform into a hitscan attack that grants self-healing on hit and is capable of dealing critical hits.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the Void Magic Mark is never cleared, allowing her to indefinitely sustain the hitscan attack form.

Teamup.name: VAMPIRIC KIN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Deploy a Vampiric Field. Allies standing within the field gain Life Steal when attacking enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, allies inside the field receive an additional Continuous Healing effect.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPARKLE MARK
ActiveAbilities.text: Hitting targets with Dazzling Detonation and Firework Finale applies a Sparkle Mark. Energy Plasmoids can detonate marks, granting allies a Healing Boost and Bonus Health, while dealing damage to enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: ENERGY PLASMOIDS
ActiveAbilities.text: Fire lumikinetic explosive light blasts forward to heal friends and damage foes. Triggering a Sparkle Mark briefly boosts Attack Speed and enables firing without consuming energy.

ActiveAbilities.name: BLOOMING BALL
ActiveAbilities.text: Launch a tracking orb of vampiric energy that damages enemies and heals allies in its radius. Striking the orb or hitting targets near it charges it up, increasing both its size and healing power. Press F to manually recall it.

ActiveAbilities.name: SPARKING SPRINT
ActiveAbilities.text: Wrap yourself in vampiric energy to gain a Speed Boost. While active, jump height and Attack Speed are increased, and Energy Blasts can be fired at no cost. Upon completion, generate a fireworks energy field around you, dealing damage and knocking back enemies, whilst healing allies.

ActiveAbilities.name: DAZZLING DETONATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Detonate a firework energy orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area and applying Blind and Vulnerability effects. The energy can also be transferred to an ally, granting them healing and a Speed Boost.

ActiveAbilities.name: FIREWORK FINALE
ActiveAbilities.text: Charge up and unleash a massive ring of outward-flying firework clusters, Launching Up nearby enemies. These clusters then orbit you, creating a field that damages enemies and heals allies. Expanding the cluster radius outward will Launch Up struck enemies.

heroes.name: Rogue
heroes.description: Anna Marie possesses the Mutant ability to absorb the powers of others with a touch. Her ever-adaptable arsenal of superhuman abilities helps turn the tide of any fight. After touching Raw Chronovium, Rogue's strength soared to new heights, allowing her to overwhelm enemies with unstoppable force!

Teamup.name: TELEKINETIC BEATDOWN
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Fire a telekinetic shockwave forward. If it lands, the Phoenix Force rushes the enemy and delivers a powerful punch. If there are other targets nearby, the Phoenix Force rapidly blinks between them to strike them as well, inflicting a Spark on each victim while healing Phoenix.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rogue, add an additional Spark stack, gain more healing, and increase the maximum number of strikes.

Teamup.name: MR. & MRS. X
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: After activation, every attack triggers a kinetic explosion, dealing area damage to surrounding enemies while simultaneously healing nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Rogue remains permanently locked in the "Hearts as One" state.

Teamup.name: EXPLOSIVE ENTANGLEMENT
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Defensive Stance is fortified. Activating the ability expands a magnetic field, drastically boosting the Damage Reduction ratio of Defensive Stance. Furthermore, all damage absorbed by the field is converted directly into damage for Southern Brawl.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, Southern Brawl Knocks back enemies. Extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall.

ActiveAbilities.name: POWER SURGE PUNCH
ActiveAbilities.text: Punch forward with both fists.

ActiveAbilities.name: DEFENSIVE STANCE
ActiveAbilities.text: Absorb nearby projectiles and reduce incoming damage; absorbed damage powers up your next Southern Brawl.

ActiveAbilities.name: SOUTHERN BRAWL
ActiveAbilities.text: While in Defensive Stance, dash forward and slam enemies in front, dealing area damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: CHRONO KICK COMBO
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward and launch the enemy, entering flight; activate again to Knock Down nearby enemies. Your next two Power Surge Punch attacks become ranged, piercing enemies and granting Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: FATAL ATTRACTION
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward. Press again to unleash a burst of Chronovium Power from her ring, dealing continuous damage to nearby foes; after a delay, the energy retracts, pulling all enemies towards Rogue.

ActiveAbilities.name: ABILITY ABSORPTION
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward to knock down your target and absorb their energy; after absorbing, replace Ability Absorption with one of their abilities or refresh Fatal Attraction. Also, absorb Health and stats based on their role.

ActiveAbilities.name: HEARTBREAKER
ActiveAbilities.text: Continuously absorb Ultimate Ability Energy from nearby enemies and steal stats based on their role.

heroes.name: The Hood
heroes.description: As the Hood, Parker Robbins is treading the dangerous path toward the throne of the criminal underworld. Cloaked in a cursed mantle, he devours the firepower of his foes, feeding his own dark might. When he transforms into his full demonic state, a torrent of dark magic sweeps over all who stand in his way!

Teamup.name: OBLIVION SHROUD
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Veil of Lightforce and Terror Cape are warped by void magic, changing into Twilight Veil and Void Veil while retaining their original effects, after traveling a set distance, the veils halt in place. Enemy damage passing through the Twilight Veil is weakened, while enemy healing passing through the Void Veil suffers Healing Reduction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the width of both the Twilight Veil and Void Veil expands. Additionally, allies passing through the veils are empowered by hellfire energy, gaining Damage Boost for a duration.

Teamup.name: VOID PENTAGRAM
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Casting Stepping Discs within an Void Magic Circle refunds energy, and each use of Stepping Discs summons a Limbo Demon.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the summoned Limbo Demons have heavily increased Health and a wider attack range.

Teamup.name: HELLFIRE SPARKS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: When Attack Speed is enhanced, Energy Plasmoids transform into a hitscan attack that grants self-healing on hit and is capable of dealing critical hits.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the Void Magic Mark is never cleared, allowing her to indefinitely sustain the hitscan attack form.

ActiveAbilities.name: ACCURSED PISTOLS
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot forward dual-wielded pistols. Gain increased Attack Speed when Demonic Energy exceeds 50%.

ActiveAbilities.name: LEADED TRANSFORMATION
ActiveAbilities.text: Enter Half-Demon State, transforming your arms into demonic rifles to unleash a rain of lead. These rifles have increased Attack Speed and Infinite Ammo. Every bullet that strikes an enemy triggers Lifesteal.

ActiveAbilities.name: MANTLE OF OBLIVION
ActiveAbilities.text: Spread your cloak to form a spherical barrier, blocking incoming enemy attacks. When Demonic Energy exceeds 50%, the radius of the sphere expands further.

ActiveAbilities.name: ABYSSAL VEIL
ActiveAbilities.text: Throw a dark magic sphere that generates a Veil upon landing. Accursed Pistols shots passing through it generate more Demonic Energy and bullets from Leaded Transformation gain increased Lifesteal. Enemy projectiles passing through suffer reduced damage and healing output. Enemies who pass through the Veil take damage and are Blinded.

ActiveAbilities.name: VOID WALK
ActiveAbilities.text: Enter the Void for free-flight. Upon reappearing, gain a decaying Movement Boost and damage surrounding enemies.

ActiveAbilities.name: DEMON OF THE END
ActiveAbilities.text: Enter Full Demon State. Fire up to 6 high-powered shots that pierce through enemies and barriers, while granting Bonus Health to yourself and nearby allies; the final bullet is the most powerful. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health to yourself and nearby allies.

Passives.name: RUINOUS PACT
Passives.text: Accumulate Demonic Energy by dealing damage via Accursed Pistols, blocking attacks with Mantle of Oblivion, or by using Void Walk. Reaching full energy automatically triggers the Half-Demon State.

heroes.name: Gorr The God Butcher
heroes.description: Wielding All-Black the Necrosword, Gorr is the nightmare of all gods. The divine flesh he rends is reshaped into an endless tide of black berserkers, forever marching in his wake. When the God Butcher's unholy legion descends, beings both mortal and divine become sacrifices beneath his feet!

ActiveAbilities.name: ALL-BLACK
ActiveAbilities.text: Unleash up to a 4-strike rapid combo with All-Black the Necrosword.

ActiveAbilities.name: NECRO-POWER
ActiveAbilities.text: Charge and launch a symbiote mass forward. Hitting an enemy Slows and teleports nearby Black Berserkers to them, or spawns a new one. Arriving Berserkers unleash a two-strike melee attack to Launch Up nearby enemies before reverting to ranged mode.

ActiveAbilities.name: SHADOW HARVEST
ActiveAbilities.text: Warp to a selected Black Berserker, sacrificing it for Bonus Health equal to half its Health and triggering a symbiote explosion. Briefly unlocks Shadow Scythe: fire a piercing shockwave forward. All-Black then becomes a scythe for a set duration or 4 slashes.

ActiveAbilities.name: LIVING ABYSS
ActiveAbilities.text: Surge forward as an Invincible symbiote mass, leaving a Black Berserker behind and driving all active Berserkers into a Frenzied State. Upon landing, manifest a Necroverse that continuously damages trapped enemies, converting them into Bonus Health.

ActiveAbilities.name: TWILIGHT OF THE GODS
ActiveAbilities.text: Transform All-Black into the ​Annihilablade​. Instantly spawn a Black Berserker beside all enemies in range. While active, slashes deal devastating damage. Berserkers in range will not expire and remain in a Frenzied State.

ActiveAbilities.name: SYMBIOTE SWARM
ActiveAbilities.text: Black Berserker damage grants Gorr Bonus Health. Defeating an enemy instantly spawns a Black Berserker at their location.

heroes.name: Deadpool (Vanguard)
heroes.description: Wade Wilson is the full package (or so he claims), with devastating damage output, an impenetrable shield, and swift healing. There's no limit to what Deadpool can achieve, as long as he keeps his moves flashy! And, of course, every epic attack comes with an endless barrage of witty banter!
