Teamup.name: MR. POOL'S INTERDIMENSIONAL TOY BOX
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to spit out a Deadpool Plushie. The plushie continuously Taunts nearby enemies while spraying a healing mist onto surrounding allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, the Deadpool Plushie asserts a much stronger Taunt while concurrently damaging enemies caught in its radius.

Teamup.name: GUMBO CHIMICHANGAS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, Duelist/Vanguard Deadpool scatters a ring of kinetically charged Chimichangas that deal damage to enemies. Strategist Deadpool's Chimichangas additionally heal allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

Teamup.name: "HEL-YEAH, HONEY"
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health. Strategist gains additional healing when unleashing the undead energy.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

Teamup.name: LOUDMOUTH MERCS
Teamup.text:
Base Effect: Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. After a timer, the bullet auto-recalls, healing Elsa based on the damage dealt while adding one extra gauge block to her Inherited Instinct passive cap.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, Deadpool breaks the fourth wall, significantly boosting Instinct acquisition rate.

ActiveAbilities.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - DUELIST
ActiveAbilities.text: Shoot enemies with dual Desert Eagles.

ActiveAbilities.name: BUNNY HOP
ActiveAbilities.text: Perform a double jump. Using Bunny Hop over others' heads or near vertical walls refreshes the cooldown. Stomping enemies grants Bonus Health and deals damage.

ActiveAbilities.name: PWNAGE POUND
ActiveAbilities.text: Select an enemy to taunt. They take damage whenever they miss an ability during the effect.

ActiveAbilities.name: UPGRADE!
ActiveAbilities.text: Deal damage to accumulate XP. When maxed, choose an ability to upgrade. Landing final hits and taking a selfie grants bonus XP. Deadpool is Invincible while taking photos.

ActiveAbilities.name: MAGICAL UNICORN SHIELD!
ActiveAbilities.text: Throw a plush toy forward; upon landing, it generates a spherical shield that blocks enemy attacks.

ActiveAbilities.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - DUELIST
ActiveAbilities.text: Taunt and deal continuous damage to nearby enemies, disrupting their vision while healing allies in range.

ActiveAbilities.name: SLICE AND DICE!
ActiveAbilities.text: Switch to dual katanas.

ActiveAbilities.name: HEADSHOT! - DUELIST
ActiveAbilities.text: Remove your Avatar and throw it, damaging enemies along the path and nearby; after a short time, it returns to you.

ActiveAbilities.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - DUELIST
ActiveAbilities.text: Slash forward with dual katanas.

ActiveAbilities.name: FINAL EXAM
ActiveAbilities.text: Initiate a challenge for yourself while gaining Healing Over Time for you and nearby allies. Hit enough enemies with the indicated abilities in time for greatly enhanced Healing.

ActiveAbilities.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - DUELIST
ActiveAbilities.text: Dash forward and slash, striking enemies in your path while healing allies in range.

ActiveAbilities.name: LOCK AND LOAD!
ActiveAbilities.text: Switch to dual pistols.

Passives.name: HEALING FACTOR
Passives.text: Continuously heal while out of combat. When taking heavy fatal damage, briefly become invincible and rapidly heal.

Passives.name: MAXIMUM FLAIR
Passives.text: Increase your Style Rating by landing abilities. Ultimate Ability can be unleashed after reaching an "S" rating.
